164 #define JSON_CATCH(exception) if(false)

210#define NLOHMANN_JSON_SERIALIZE_ENUM(ENUM_TYPE, ...) \
211 template<typename BasicJsonType> \
212 inline void to_json(BasicJsonType& j, const ENUM_TYPE& e) \
213 { \
214 static_assert(std::is_enum<ENUM_TYPE>::value, #ENUM_TYPE " must be an enum!"); \
215 static const std::pair<ENUM_TYPE, BasicJsonType> m[] = __VA_ARGS__; \
216 auto it = std::find_if(std::begin(m), std::end(m), \
217 [e](const std::pair<ENUM_TYPE, BasicJsonType>& ej_pair) -> bool \
218 { \
219 return ej_pair.first == e; \
220 }); \
221 j = ((it != std::end(m)) ? it : std::begin(m))->second; \
222 } \
223 template<typename BasicJsonType> \
224 inline void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, ENUM_TYPE& e) \
225 { \
226 static_assert(std::is_enum<ENUM_TYPE>::value, #ENUM_TYPE " must be an enum!"); \
227 static const std::pair<ENUM_TYPE, BasicJsonType> m[] = __VA_ARGS__; \
228 auto it = std::find_if(std::begin(m), std::end(m), \
229 [j](const std::pair<ENUM_TYPE, BasicJsonType>& ej_pair) -> bool \
230 { \
231 return ej_pair.second == j; \
232 }); \
233 e = ((it != std::end(m)) ? it : std::begin(m))->first; \
234 }

270// implementation of C++14 index_sequence and affiliates
271// source: https://stackoverflow.com/a/32223343
272template<std::size_t... Ints>
273struct index_sequence
274{
275 using type = index_sequence;
276 using value_type = std::size_t;
277 static constexpr std::size_t size() noexcept
278 {
279 return sizeof...(Ints);
280 }
281};

283template<class Sequence1, class Sequence2>
284struct merge_and_renumber;
285
286template<std::size_t... I1, std::size_t... I2>
287struct merge_and_renumber<index_sequence<I1...>, index_sequence<I2...>>
288 : index_sequence < I1..., (sizeof...(I1) + I2)... > {};
289
290template<std::size_t N>
291struct make_index_sequence
292 : merge_and_renumber < typename make_index_sequence < N / 2 >::type,
293 typename make_index_sequence < N - N / 2 >::type > {};
294
295template<> struct make_index_sequence<0> : index_sequence<> {};
296template<> struct make_index_sequence<1> : index_sequence<0> {};
297
298template<typename... Ts>
299using index_sequence_for = make_index_sequence<sizeof...(Ts)>;

355struct nonesuch
356{
357 nonesuch() = delete;
358 ~nonesuch() = delete;
359 nonesuch(nonesuch const&) = delete;
360 void operator=(nonesuch const&) = delete;
361};
362
363template <class Default,
364 class AlwaysVoid,
365 template <class...> class Op,
366 class... Args>
367struct detector
368{
369 using value_t = std::false_type;
370 using type = Default;
371};
372
373template <class Default, template <class...> class Op, class... Args>
374struct detector<Default, void_t<Op<Args...>>, Op, Args...>
375{
376 using value_t = std::true_type;
377 using type = Op<Args...>;
378};
379
380template <template <class...> class Op, class... Args>
381using is_detected = typename detector<nonesuch, void, Op, Args...>::value_t;
382
383template <template <class...> class Op, class... Args>
384using detected_t = typename detector<nonesuch, void, Op, Args...>::type;
385
386template <class Default, template <class...> class Op, class... Args>
387using detected_or = detector<Default, void, Op, Args...>;
388
389template <class Default, template <class...> class Op, class... Args>
390using detected_or_t = typename detected_or<Default, Op, Args...>::type;
391
392template <class Expected, template <class...> class Op, class... Args>
393using is_detected_exact = std::is_same<Expected, detected_t<Op, Args...>>;
394
395template <class To, template <class...> class Op, class... Args>
396using is_detected_convertible =
397 std::is_convertible<detected_t<Op, Args...>, To>;
398} // namespace detail
399} // namespace nlohmann

420// Note to maintainers:
421//
422// Every trait in this file expects a non CV-qualified type.
423// The only exceptions are in the 'aliases for detected' section

471// trait checking if JSONSerializer<T>::from_json(json const&, udt&) exists
472template <typename BasicJsonType, typename T, typename = void>
473struct has_from_json : std::false_type {};
474
475template <typename BasicJsonType, typename T>
476struct has_from_json<BasicJsonType, T,
477 enable_if_t<not is_basic_json<T>::value>>
478{
479 using serializer = typename BasicJsonType::template json_serializer<T, void>;
480
481 static constexpr bool value =
482 is_detected_exact<void, from_json_function, serializer,
483 const BasicJsonType&, T&>::value;
484};
485
486// This trait checks if JSONSerializer<T>::from_json(json const&) exists
487// this overload is used for non-default-constructible user-defined-types
488template <typename BasicJsonType, typename T, typename = void>
489struct has_non_default_from_json : std::false_type {};
490
491template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T>
492struct has_non_default_from_json<BasicJsonType, T, enable_if_t<not is_basic_json<T>::value>>
493{
494 using serializer = typename BasicJsonType::template json_serializer<T, void>;
495
496 static constexpr bool value =
497 is_detected_exact<T, from_json_function, serializer,
498 const BasicJsonType&>::value;
499};

501// This trait checks if BasicJsonType::json_serializer<T>::to_json exists
502// Do not evaluate the trait when T is a basic_json type, to avoid template instantiation infinite recursion.
503template <typename BasicJsonType, typename T, typename = void>
504struct has_to_json : std::false_type {};
505
506template <typename BasicJsonType, typename T>
507struct has_to_json<BasicJsonType, T, enable_if_t<not is_basic_json<T>::value>>
508{
509 using serializer = typename BasicJsonType::template json_serializer<T, void>;
510
511 static constexpr bool value =
512 is_detected_exact<void, to_json_function, serializer, BasicJsonType&,
513 T>::value;
514};

547template <typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleObjectType,
548 typename = void>
549struct is_compatible_object_type_impl : std::false_type {};
550
551template <typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleObjectType>
552struct is_compatible_object_type_impl <
553 BasicJsonType, CompatibleObjectType,
554 enable_if_t<is_detected<mapped_type_t, CompatibleObjectType>::value and
555 is_detected<key_type_t, CompatibleObjectType>::value >>
556{
557
558 using object_t = typename BasicJsonType::object_t;
559
560 // macOS's is_constructible does not play well with nonesuch...
561 static constexpr bool value =
562 std::is_constructible<typename object_t::key_type,
563 typename CompatibleObjectType::key_type>::value and
564 std::is_constructible<typename object_t::mapped_type,
565 typename CompatibleObjectType::mapped_type>::value;
566};

576template <typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleObjectType>
577struct is_constructible_object_type_impl <
578 BasicJsonType, ConstructibleObjectType,
579 enable_if_t<is_detected<mapped_type_t, ConstructibleObjectType>::value and
580 is_detected<key_type_t, ConstructibleObjectType>::value >>
581{
582 using object_t = typename BasicJsonType::object_t;
583
584 static constexpr bool value =
585 (std::is_constructible<typename ConstructibleObjectType::key_type, typename object_t::key_type>::value and
586 std::is_same<typename object_t::mapped_type, typename ConstructibleObjectType::mapped_type>::value) or
587 (has_from_json<BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleObjectType::mapped_type>::value or
588 has_non_default_from_json<BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleObjectType::mapped_type >::value);
589};

633template <typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleArrayType, typename = void>
634struct is_compatible_array_type_impl : std::false_type {};
635
636template <typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleArrayType>
637struct is_compatible_array_type_impl <
638 BasicJsonType, CompatibleArrayType,
639 enable_if_t<is_detected<value_type_t, CompatibleArrayType>::value and
640 is_detected<iterator_t, CompatibleArrayType>::value and
641// This is needed because json_reverse_iterator has a ::iterator type...
642// Therefore it is detected as a CompatibleArrayType.
643// The real fix would be to have an Iterable concept.
644 not is_iterator_traits<
645 std::iterator_traits<CompatibleArrayType>>::value >>
646{
647 static constexpr bool value =
648 std::is_constructible<BasicJsonType,
649 typename CompatibleArrayType::value_type>::value;
650};
651
652template <typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleArrayType>
653struct is_compatible_array_type
654 : is_compatible_array_type_impl<BasicJsonType, CompatibleArrayType> {};

656template <typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleArrayType, typename = void>
657struct is_constructible_array_type_impl : std::false_type {};
658
659template <typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleArrayType>
660struct is_constructible_array_type_impl <
661 BasicJsonType, ConstructibleArrayType,
662 enable_if_t<std::is_same<ConstructibleArrayType,
663 typename BasicJsonType::value_type>::value >>
664 : std::true_type {};
665
666template <typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleArrayType>
667struct is_constructible_array_type_impl <
668 BasicJsonType, ConstructibleArrayType,
669 enable_if_t<not std::is_same<ConstructibleArrayType,
670 typename BasicJsonType::value_type>::value and
671 is_detected<value_type_t, ConstructibleArrayType>::value and
672 is_detected<iterator_t, ConstructibleArrayType>::value and
673 is_complete_type<
674 detected_t<value_type_t, ConstructibleArrayType>>::value >>
675{
676 static constexpr bool value =
677 // This is needed because json_reverse_iterator has a ::iterator type,
678 // furthermore, std::back_insert_iterator (and other iterators) have a base class `iterator`...
679 // Therefore it is detected as a ConstructibleArrayType.
680 // The real fix would be to have an Iterable concept.
681 not is_iterator_traits <
682 std::iterator_traits<ConstructibleArrayType >>::value and
683
684 (std::is_same<typename ConstructibleArrayType::value_type, typename BasicJsonType::array_t::value_type>::value or
685 has_from_json<BasicJsonType,
686 typename ConstructibleArrayType::value_type>::value or
687 has_non_default_from_json <
688 BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleArrayType::value_type >::value);
689};

699template <typename RealIntegerType, typename CompatibleNumberIntegerType>
700struct is_compatible_integer_type_impl <
701 RealIntegerType, CompatibleNumberIntegerType,
702 enable_if_t<std::is_integral<RealIntegerType>::value and
703 std::is_integral<CompatibleNumberIntegerType>::value and
704 not std::is_same<bool, CompatibleNumberIntegerType>::value >>
705{
706 // is there an assert somewhere on overflows?
707 using RealLimits = std::numeric_limits<RealIntegerType>;
708 using CompatibleLimits = std::numeric_limits<CompatibleNumberIntegerType>;
709
710 static constexpr auto value =
711 std::is_constructible<RealIntegerType,
712 CompatibleNumberIntegerType>::value and
713 CompatibleLimits::is_integer and
714 RealLimits::is_signed == CompatibleLimits::is_signed;
715};
716
717template <typename RealIntegerType, typename CompatibleNumberIntegerType>
718struct is_compatible_integer_type
719 : is_compatible_integer_type_impl<RealIntegerType,
720 CompatibleNumberIntegerType> {};
721
722template <typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleType, typename = void>
723struct is_compatible_type_impl: std::false_type {};
724
725template <typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleType>
726struct is_compatible_type_impl <
727 BasicJsonType, CompatibleType,
728 enable_if_t<is_complete_type<CompatibleType>::value >>
729{
730 static constexpr bool value =
731 has_to_json<BasicJsonType, CompatibleType>::value;
732};
733
734template <typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleType>
735struct is_compatible_type
736 : is_compatible_type_impl<BasicJsonType, CompatibleType> {};
737} // namespace detail
738} // namespace nlohmann

813class exception : public std::exception
814{
815 public:
817 const char* what() const noexcept override
818 {
819 return m.what();
820 }
821
823 const int id;
824
825 protected:
826 exception(int id_, const char* what_arg) : id(id_), m(what_arg) {}
827
828 static std::string name(const std::string& ename, int id_)
829 {
830 return "[json.exception." + ename + "." + std::to_string(id_) + "] ";
831 }
832
833 private:
835 std::runtime_error m;
836};
837
882class parse_error : public exception
883{
884 public:
894 static parse_error create(int id_, const position_t& pos, const std::string& what_arg)
895 {
896 std::string w = exception::name("parse_error", id_) + "parse error" +
897 position_string(pos) + ": " + what_arg;
898 return parse_error(id_, pos.chars_read_total, w.c_str());
899 }
900
901 static parse_error create(int id_, std::size_t byte_, const std::string& what_arg)
902 {
903 std::string w = exception::name("parse_error", id_) + "parse error" +
904 (byte_ != 0 ? (" at byte " + std::to_string(byte_)) : "") +
905 ": " + what_arg;
906 return parse_error(id_, byte_, w.c_str());
907 }
908
918 const std::size_t byte;
919
920 private:
921 parse_error(int id_, std::size_t byte_, const char* what_arg)
922 : exception(id_, what_arg), byte(byte_) {}
923
924 static std::string position_string(const position_t& pos)
925 {
926 return " at line " + std::to_string(pos.lines_read + 1) +
927 ", column " + std::to_string(pos.chars_read_current_line);
928 }
929};

1132// JSON type enumeration //
1134
1159enum class value_t : std::uint8_t
1160{
1161 null,
1162 object,
1163 array,
1164 string,
1165 boolean,
1166 number_integer,
1167 number_unsigned,
1168 number_float,
1169 discarded
1170};
1171
1182inline bool operator<(const value_t lhs, const value_t rhs) noexcept
1183{
1184 static constexpr std::array<std::uint8_t, 8> order = {{
1185 0 /* null */, 3 /* object */, 4 /* array */, 5 /* string */,
1186 1 /* boolean */, 2 /* integer */, 2 /* unsigned */, 2 /* float */
1187 }
1188 };
1189
1190 const auto l_index = static_cast<std::size_t>(lhs);
1191 const auto r_index = static_cast<std::size_t>(rhs);
1192 return l_index < order.size() and r_index < order.size() and order[l_index] < order[r_index];
1193}
1194} // namespace detail
1195} // namespace nlohmann

1228template<typename BasicJsonType>
1229void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, typename std::nullptr_t& n)
1230{
1231 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not j.is_null()))
1232 {
1233 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be null, but is " + std::string(j.type_name())));
1234 }
1235 n = nullptr;
1236}
1237
1238// overloads for basic_json template parameters
1239template<typename BasicJsonType, typename ArithmeticType,
1240 enable_if_t<std::is_arithmetic<ArithmeticType>::value and
1241 not std::is_same<ArithmeticType, typename BasicJsonType::boolean_t>::value,
1242 int> = 0>
1243void get_arithmetic_value(const BasicJsonType& j, ArithmeticType& val)
1244{
1245 switch (static_cast<value_t>(j))
1246 {
1247 case value_t::number_unsigned:
1248 {
1249 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t*>());
1250 break;
1251 }
1252 case value_t::number_integer:
1253 {
1254 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t*>());
1255 break;
1256 }
1257 case value_t::number_float:
1258 {
1259 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t*>());
1260 break;
1261 }
1262
1263 default:
1264 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be number, but is " + std::string(j.type_name())));
1265 }
1266}
1267
1268template<typename BasicJsonType>
1269void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, typename BasicJsonType::boolean_t& b)
1270{
1271 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not j.is_boolean()))
1272 {
1273 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be boolean, but is " + std::string(j.type_name())));
1274 }
1275 b = *j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::boolean_t*>();
1276}
1277
1278template<typename BasicJsonType>
1279void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, typename BasicJsonType::string_t& s)
1280{
1281 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not j.is_string()))
1282 {
1283 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be string, but is " + std::string(j.type_name())));
1284 }
1285 s = *j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::string_t*>();
1286}
1287
1288template <
1289 typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleStringType,
1290 enable_if_t <
1291 is_constructible_string_type<BasicJsonType, ConstructibleStringType>::value and
1292 not std::is_same<typename BasicJsonType::string_t,
1293 ConstructibleStringType>::value,
1294 int > = 0 >
1295void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, ConstructibleStringType& s)
1296{
1297 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not j.is_string()))
1298 {
1299 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be string, but is " + std::string(j.type_name())));
1300 }
1301
1302 s = *j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::string_t*>();
1303}
1304
1305template<typename BasicJsonType>
1306void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t& val)
1307{
1308 get_arithmetic_value(j, val);
1309}
1310
1311template<typename BasicJsonType>
1312void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t& val)
1313{
1314 get_arithmetic_value(j, val);
1315}
1316
1317template<typename BasicJsonType>
1318void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t& val)
1319{
1320 get_arithmetic_value(j, val);
1321}
1322
1323template<typename BasicJsonType, typename EnumType,
1324 enable_if_t<std::is_enum<EnumType>::value, int> = 0>
1325void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, EnumType& e)
1326{
1327 typename std::underlying_type<EnumType>::type val;
1328 get_arithmetic_value(j, val);
1329 e = static_cast<EnumType>(val);
1330}

1332// forward_list doesn't have an insert method
1333template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T, typename Allocator,
1334 enable_if_t<std::is_convertible<BasicJsonType, T>::value, int> = 0>
1335void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, std::forward_list<T, Allocator>& l)
1336{
1337 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not j.is_array()))
1338 {
1339 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be array, but is " + std::string(j.type_name())));
1340 }
1341 std::transform(j.rbegin(), j.rend(),
1342 std::front_inserter(l), [](const BasicJsonType & i)
1343 {
1344 return i.template get<T>();
1345 });
1346}
1347
1348// valarray doesn't have an insert method
1349template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T,
1350 enable_if_t<std::is_convertible<BasicJsonType, T>::value, int> = 0>
1351void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, std::valarray<T>& l)
1352{
1353 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not j.is_array()))
1354 {
1355 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be array, but is " + std::string(j.type_name())));
1356 }
1357 l.resize(j.size());
1358 std::copy(j.m_value.array->begin(), j.m_value.array->end(), std::begin(l));
1359}

1361template<typename BasicJsonType>
1362void from_json_array_impl(const BasicJsonType& j, typename BasicJsonType::array_t& arr, priority_tag<3> /*unused*/)
1363{
1364 arr = *j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::array_t*>();
1365}
1366
1367template <typename BasicJsonType, typename T, std::size_t N>
1368auto from_json_array_impl(const BasicJsonType& j, std::array<T, N>& arr,
1369 priority_tag<2> /*unused*/)
1370-> decltype(j.template get<T>(), void())
1371{
1372 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i)
1373 {
1374 arr[i] = j.at(i).template get<T>();
1375 }
1376}
1377
1378template<typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleArrayType>
1379auto from_json_array_impl(const BasicJsonType& j, ConstructibleArrayType& arr, priority_tag<1> /*unused*/)
1380-> decltype(
1381 arr.reserve(std::declval<typename ConstructibleArrayType::size_type>()),
1382 j.template get<typename ConstructibleArrayType::value_type>(),
1383 void())
1384{
1385 using std::end;
1386
1387 arr.reserve(j.size());
1388 std::transform(j.begin(), j.end(),
1389 std::inserter(arr, end(arr)), [](const BasicJsonType & i)
1390 {
1391 // get<BasicJsonType>() returns *this, this won't call a from_json
1392 // method when value_type is BasicJsonType
1393 return i.template get<typename ConstructibleArrayType::value_type>();
1394 });
1395}
1396
1397template <typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleArrayType>
1398void from_json_array_impl(const BasicJsonType& j, ConstructibleArrayType& arr,
1399 priority_tag<0> /*unused*/)
1400{
1401 using std::end;
1402
1403 std::transform(
1404 j.begin(), j.end(), std::inserter(arr, end(arr)),
1405 [](const BasicJsonType & i)
1406 {
1407 // get<BasicJsonType>() returns *this, this won't call a from_json
1408 // method when value_type is BasicJsonType
1409 return i.template get<typename ConstructibleArrayType::value_type>();
1410 });
1411}
1412
1413template <typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleArrayType,
1414 enable_if_t <
1415 is_constructible_array_type<BasicJsonType, ConstructibleArrayType>::value and
1416 not is_constructible_object_type<BasicJsonType, ConstructibleArrayType>::value and
1417 not is_constructible_string_type<BasicJsonType, ConstructibleArrayType>::value and
1418 not is_basic_json<ConstructibleArrayType>::value,
1419 int > = 0 >
1420
1421auto from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, ConstructibleArrayType& arr)
1422-> decltype(from_json_array_impl(j, arr, priority_tag<3> {}),
1423j.template get<typename ConstructibleArrayType::value_type>(),
1424void())
1425{
1426 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not j.is_array()))
1427 {
1428 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be array, but is " +
1429 std::string(j.type_name())));
1430 }
1431
1432 from_json_array_impl(j, arr, priority_tag<3> {});
1433}
1434
1435template<typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleObjectType,
1436 enable_if_t<is_constructible_object_type<BasicJsonType, ConstructibleObjectType>::value, int> = 0>
1437void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, ConstructibleObjectType& obj)
1438{
1439 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not j.is_object()))
1440 {
1441 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be object, but is " + std::string(j.type_name())));
1442 }
1443
1444 auto inner_object = j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::object_t*>();
1445 using value_type = typename ConstructibleObjectType::value_type;
1446 std::transform(
1447 inner_object->begin(), inner_object->end(),
1448 std::inserter(obj, obj.begin()),
1449 [](typename BasicJsonType::object_t::value_type const & p)
1450 {
1451 return value_type(p.first, p.second.template get<typename ConstructibleObjectType::mapped_type>());
1452 });
1453}
1454
1455// overload for arithmetic types, not chosen for basic_json template arguments
1456// (BooleanType, etc..); note: Is it really necessary to provide explicit
1457// overloads for boolean_t etc. in case of a custom BooleanType which is not
1458// an arithmetic type?
1459template<typename BasicJsonType, typename ArithmeticType,
1460 enable_if_t <
1461 std::is_arithmetic<ArithmeticType>::value and
1462 not std::is_same<ArithmeticType, typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t>::value and
1463 not std::is_same<ArithmeticType, typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t>::value and
1464 not std::is_same<ArithmeticType, typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t>::value and
1465 not std::is_same<ArithmeticType, typename BasicJsonType::boolean_t>::value,
1466 int> = 0>
1467void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, ArithmeticType& val)
1468{
1469 switch (static_cast<value_t>(j))
1470 {
1471 case value_t::number_unsigned:
1472 {
1473 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t*>());
1474 break;
1475 }
1476 case value_t::number_integer:
1477 {
1478 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t*>());
1479 break;
1480 }
1481 case value_t::number_float:
1482 {
1483 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t*>());
1484 break;
1485 }
1486 case value_t::boolean:
1487 {
1488 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::boolean_t*>());
1489 break;
1490 }
1491
1492 default:
1493 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be number, but is " + std::string(j.type_name())));
1494 }
1495}
1496
1497template<typename BasicJsonType, typename A1, typename A2>
1498void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, std::pair<A1, A2>& p)
1499{
1500 p = {j.at(0).template get<A1>(), j.at(1).template get<A2>()};
1501}

1503template<typename BasicJsonType, typename Tuple, std::size_t... Idx>
1504void from_json_tuple_impl(const BasicJsonType& j, Tuple& t, index_sequence<Idx...> /*unused*/)
1505{
1506 t = std::make_tuple(j.at(Idx).template get<typename std::tuple_element<Idx, Tuple>::type>()...);
1507}

1509template<typename BasicJsonType, typename... Args>
1510void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, std::tuple<Args...>& t)
1511{
1512 from_json_tuple_impl(j, t, index_sequence_for<Args...> {});

1515template <typename BasicJsonType, typename Key, typename Value, typename Compare, typename Allocator,
1516 typename = enable_if_t<not std::is_constructible<
1517 typename BasicJsonType::string_t, Key>::value>>
1518void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, std::map<Key, Value, Compare, Allocator>& m)
1519{
1520 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not j.is_array()))
1521 {
1522 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be array, but is " + std::string(j.type_name())));
1523 }
1524 for (const auto& p : j)
1525 {
1526 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not p.is_array()))
1527 {
1528 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be array, but is " + std::string(p.type_name())));
1529 }
1530 m.emplace(p.at(0).template get<Key>(), p.at(1).template get<Value>());
1531 }
1532}
1533
1534template <typename BasicJsonType, typename Key, typename Value, typename Hash, typename KeyEqual, typename Allocator,
1535 typename = enable_if_t<not std::is_constructible<
1536 typename BasicJsonType::string_t, Key>::value>>
1537void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, std::unordered_map<Key, Value, Hash, KeyEqual, Allocator>& m)
1538{
1539 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not j.is_array()))
1540 {
1541 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be array, but is " + std::string(j.type_name())));
1542 }
1543 for (const auto& p : j)
1544 {
1545 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not p.is_array()))
1546 {
1547 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be array, but is " + std::string(p.type_name())));
1548 }
1549 m.emplace(p.at(0).template get<Key>(), p.at(1).template get<Value>());
1550 }
1551}
1552
1553struct from_json_fn
1554{
1555 template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T>
1556 auto operator()(const BasicJsonType& j, T& val) const
1557 noexcept(noexcept(from_json(j, val)))
1558 -> decltype(from_json(j, val), void())
1559 {
1560 return from_json(j, val);
1561 }
1562};

1606template<typename IteratorType> class iteration_proxy
1607{
1608 private:
1610 class iteration_proxy_internal
1611 {
1612 public:
1613 using difference_type = std::ptrdiff_t;
1614 using value_type = iteration_proxy_internal;
1615 using pointer = iteration_proxy_internal*;
1616 using reference = iteration_proxy_internal&;
1617 using iterator_category = std::input_iterator_tag;
1618
1619 private:
1621 IteratorType anchor;
1623 std::size_t array_index = 0;
1625 mutable std::size_t array_index_last = 0;
1627 mutable std::string array_index_str = "0";
1629 const std::string empty_str = "";
1630
1631 public:
1632 explicit iteration_proxy_internal(IteratorType it) noexcept : anchor(it) {}
1633
1635 iteration_proxy_internal& operator*()
1636 {
1637 return *this;
1638 }
1639
1641 iteration_proxy_internal& operator++()
1642 {
1643 ++anchor;
1644 ++array_index;
1645
1646 return *this;
1647 }
1648
1650 bool operator==(const iteration_proxy_internal& o) const noexcept
1651 {
1652 return anchor == o.anchor;
1653 }
1654
1656 bool operator!=(const iteration_proxy_internal& o) const noexcept
1657 {
1658 return anchor != o.anchor;
1659 }
1660
1662 const std::string& key() const
1663 {
1664 assert(anchor.m_object != nullptr);
1665
1666 switch (anchor.m_object->type())
1667 {
1668 // use integer array index as key
1669 case value_t::array:
1670 {
1671 if (array_index != array_index_last)
1672 {
1673 array_index_str = std::to_string(array_index);
1674 array_index_last = array_index;
1675 }
1676 return array_index_str;
1677 }
1678
1679 // use key from the object
1680 case value_t::object:
1681 return anchor.key();
1682
1683 // use an empty key for all primitive types
1684 default:
1685 return empty_str;
1686 }
1687 }
1688
1690 typename IteratorType::reference value() const
1691 {
1692 return anchor.value();
1693 }
1694 };
1695
1697 typename IteratorType::reference container;
1698
1699 public:
1701 explicit iteration_proxy(typename IteratorType::reference cont) noexcept
1702 : container(cont) {}
1703
1705 iteration_proxy_internal begin() noexcept
1706 {
1707 return iteration_proxy_internal(container.begin());
1708 }
1709
1711 iteration_proxy_internal end() noexcept
1712 {
1713 return iteration_proxy_internal(container.end());
1714 }
1715};
1716} // namespace detail
1717} // namespace nlohmann

1808template<>
1809struct external_constructor<value_t::array>
1810{
1811 template<typename BasicJsonType>
1812 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, const typename BasicJsonType::array_t& arr)
1813 {
1814 j.m_type = value_t::array;
1815 j.m_value = arr;
1816 j.assert_invariant();
1817 }
1818
1819 template<typename BasicJsonType>
1820 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, typename BasicJsonType::array_t&& arr)
1821 {
1822 j.m_type = value_t::array;
1823 j.m_value = std::move(arr);
1824 j.assert_invariant();
1825 }
1826
1827 template<typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleArrayType,
1828 enable_if_t<not std::is_same<CompatibleArrayType, typename BasicJsonType::array_t>::value,
1829 int> = 0>
1830 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, const CompatibleArrayType& arr)
1831 {
1832 using std::begin;
1833 using std::end;
1834 j.m_type = value_t::array;
1835 j.m_value.array = j.template create<typename BasicJsonType::array_t>(begin(arr), end(arr));
1836 j.assert_invariant();
1837 }
1838
1839 template<typename BasicJsonType>
1840 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, const std::vector<bool>& arr)
1841 {
1842 j.m_type = value_t::array;
1843 j.m_value = value_t::array;
1844 j.m_value.array->reserve(arr.size());
1845 for (const bool x : arr)
1846 {
1847 j.m_value.array->push_back(x);
1848 }
1849 j.assert_invariant();
1850 }
1851
1852 template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T,
1853 enable_if_t<std::is_convertible<T, BasicJsonType>::value, int> = 0>
1854 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, const std::valarray<T>& arr)
1855 {
1856 j.m_type = value_t::array;
1857 j.m_value = value_t::array;
1858 j.m_value.array->resize(arr.size());
1859 std::copy(std::begin(arr), std::end(arr), j.m_value.array->begin());
1860 j.assert_invariant();
1861 }
1862};

2030struct to_json_fn
2031{
2032 template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T>
2033 auto operator()(BasicJsonType& j, T&& val) const noexcept(noexcept(to_json(j, std::forward<T>(val))))
2034 -> decltype(to_json(j, std::forward<T>(val)), void())
2035 {
2036 return to_json(j, std::forward<T>(val));
2037 }
2038};

2073// input adapters //
2075
2087struct input_adapter_protocol
2088{
2090 virtual std::char_traits<char>::int_type get_character() = 0;
2091 virtual ~input_adapter_protocol() = default;
2092};
2093
2095using input_adapter_t = std::shared_ptr<input_adapter_protocol>;
2096
2106class input_stream_adapter : public input_adapter_protocol
2107{
2108 public:
2109 ~input_stream_adapter() override
2110 {
2111 // clear stream flags; we use underlying streambuf I/O, do not
2112 // maintain ifstream flags, except eof
2113 is.clear(is.rdstate() & std::ios::eofbit);
2114 }
2115
2116 explicit input_stream_adapter(std::istream& i)
2117 : is(i), sb(*i.rdbuf())
2118 {}
2119
2120 // delete because of pointer members
2121 input_stream_adapter(const input_stream_adapter&) = delete;
2122 input_stream_adapter& operator=(input_stream_adapter&) = delete;
2123 input_stream_adapter(input_stream_adapter&&) = delete;
2124 input_stream_adapter& operator=(input_stream_adapter&&) = delete;
2125
2126 // std::istream/std::streambuf use std::char_traits<char>::to_int_type, to
2127 // ensure that std::char_traits<char>::eof() and the character 0xFF do not
2128 // end up as the same value, eg. 0xFFFFFFFF.
2129 std::char_traits<char>::int_type get_character() override
2130 {
2131 auto res = sb.sbumpc();
2132 // set eof manually, as we don't use the istream interface.
2133 if (res == EOF)
2134 {
2135 is.clear(is.rdstate() | std::ios::eofbit);
2136 }
2137 return res;
2138 }
2139
2140 private:
2142 std::istream& is;
2143 std::streambuf& sb;
2144};
2145
2147class input_buffer_adapter : public input_adapter_protocol
2148{
2149 public:
2150 input_buffer_adapter(const char* b, const std::size_t l) noexcept
2151 : cursor(b), limit(b + l)
2152 {}
2153
2154 // delete because of pointer members
2155 input_buffer_adapter(const input_buffer_adapter&) = delete;
2156 input_buffer_adapter& operator=(input_buffer_adapter&) = delete;
2157 input_buffer_adapter(input_buffer_adapter&&) = delete;
2158 input_buffer_adapter& operator=(input_buffer_adapter&&) = delete;
2159 ~input_buffer_adapter() override = default;
2160
2161 std::char_traits<char>::int_type get_character() noexcept override
2162 {
2163 if (JSON_LIKELY(cursor < limit))
2164 {
2165 return std::char_traits<char>::to_int_type(*(cursor++));
2166 }
2167
2168 return std::char_traits<char>::eof();
2169 }
2170
2171 private:
2173 const char* cursor;
2175 const char* const limit;
2176};
2177
2178template<typename WideStringType, size_t T>
2179struct wide_string_input_helper
2180{
2181 // UTF-32
2182 static void fill_buffer(const WideStringType& str, size_t& current_wchar, std::array<std::char_traits<char>::int_type, 4>& utf8_bytes, size_t& utf8_bytes_index, size_t& utf8_bytes_filled)
2183 {
2184 utf8_bytes_index = 0;
2185
2186 if (current_wchar == str.size())
2187 {
2188 utf8_bytes[0] = std::char_traits<char>::eof();
2189 utf8_bytes_filled = 1;
2190 }
2191 else
2192 {
2193 // get the current character
2194 const auto wc = static_cast<int>(str[current_wchar++]);
2195
2196 // UTF-32 to UTF-8 encoding
2197 if (wc < 0x80)
2198 {
2199 utf8_bytes[0] = wc;
2200 utf8_bytes_filled = 1;
2201 }
2202 else if (wc <= 0x7FF)
2203 {
2204 utf8_bytes[0] = 0xC0 | ((wc >> 6) & 0x1F);
2205 utf8_bytes[1] = 0x80 | (wc & 0x3F);
2206 utf8_bytes_filled = 2;
2207 }
2208 else if (wc <= 0xFFFF)
2209 {
2210 utf8_bytes[0] = 0xE0 | ((wc >> 12) & 0x0F);
2211 utf8_bytes[1] = 0x80 | ((wc >> 6) & 0x3F);
2212 utf8_bytes[2] = 0x80 | (wc & 0x3F);
2213 utf8_bytes_filled = 3;
2214 }
2215 else if (wc <= 0x10FFFF)
2216 {
2217 utf8_bytes[0] = 0xF0 | ((wc >> 18) & 0x07);
2218 utf8_bytes[1] = 0x80 | ((wc >> 12) & 0x3F);
2219 utf8_bytes[2] = 0x80 | ((wc >> 6) & 0x3F);
2220 utf8_bytes[3] = 0x80 | (wc & 0x3F);
2221 utf8_bytes_filled = 4;
2222 }
2223 else
2224 {
2225 // unknown character
2226 utf8_bytes[0] = wc;
2227 utf8_bytes_filled = 1;
2228 }
2229 }
2230 }
2231};
2232
2233template<typename WideStringType>
2234struct wide_string_input_helper<WideStringType, 2>
2235{
2236 // UTF-16
2237 static void fill_buffer(const WideStringType& str, size_t& current_wchar, std::array<std::char_traits<char>::int_type, 4>& utf8_bytes, size_t& utf8_bytes_index, size_t& utf8_bytes_filled)
2238 {
2239 utf8_bytes_index = 0;
2240
2241 if (current_wchar == str.size())
2242 {
2243 utf8_bytes[0] = std::char_traits<char>::eof();
2244 utf8_bytes_filled = 1;
2245 }
2246 else
2247 {
2248 // get the current character
2249 const auto wc = static_cast<int>(str[current_wchar++]);
2250
2251 // UTF-16 to UTF-8 encoding
2252 if (wc < 0x80)
2253 {
2254 utf8_bytes[0] = wc;
2255 utf8_bytes_filled = 1;
2256 }
2257 else if (wc <= 0x7FF)
2258 {
2259 utf8_bytes[0] = 0xC0 | ((wc >> 6));
2260 utf8_bytes[1] = 0x80 | (wc & 0x3F);
2261 utf8_bytes_filled = 2;
2262 }
2263 else if (0xD800 > wc or wc >= 0xE000)
2264 {
2265 utf8_bytes[0] = 0xE0 | ((wc >> 12));
2266 utf8_bytes[1] = 0x80 | ((wc >> 6) & 0x3F);
2267 utf8_bytes[2] = 0x80 | (wc & 0x3F);
2268 utf8_bytes_filled = 3;
2269 }
2270 else
2271 {
2272 if (current_wchar < str.size())
2273 {
2274 const auto wc2 = static_cast<int>(str[current_wchar++]);
2275 const int charcode = 0x10000 + (((wc & 0x3FF) << 10) | (wc2 & 0x3FF));
2276 utf8_bytes[0] = 0xf0 | (charcode >> 18);
2277 utf8_bytes[1] = 0x80 | ((charcode >> 12) & 0x3F);
2278 utf8_bytes[2] = 0x80 | ((charcode >> 6) & 0x3F);
2279 utf8_bytes[3] = 0x80 | (charcode & 0x3F);
2280 utf8_bytes_filled = 4;
2281 }
2282 else
2283 {
2284 // unknown character
2285 ++current_wchar;
2286 utf8_bytes[0] = wc;
2287 utf8_bytes_filled = 1;
2288 }
2289 }
2290 }
2291 }
2292};
2293
2294template<typename WideStringType>
2295class wide_string_input_adapter : public input_adapter_protocol
2296{
2297 public:
2298 explicit wide_string_input_adapter(const WideStringType& w) noexcept
2299 : str(w)
2300 {}
2301
2302 std::char_traits<char>::int_type get_character() noexcept override
2303 {
2304 // check if buffer needs to be filled
2305 if (utf8_bytes_index == utf8_bytes_filled)
2306 {
2307 fill_buffer<sizeof(typename WideStringType::value_type)>();
2308
2309 assert(utf8_bytes_filled > 0);
2310 assert(utf8_bytes_index == 0);
2311 }
2312
2313 // use buffer
2314 assert(utf8_bytes_filled > 0);
2315 assert(utf8_bytes_index < utf8_bytes_filled);
2316 return utf8_bytes[utf8_bytes_index++];
2317 }
2318
2319 private:
2320 template<size_t T>
2321 void fill_buffer()
2322 {
2323 wide_string_input_helper<WideStringType, T>::fill_buffer(str, current_wchar, utf8_bytes, utf8_bytes_index, utf8_bytes_filled);
2324 }
2325
2327 const WideStringType& str;
2328
2330 std::size_t current_wchar = 0;
2331
2333 std::array<std::char_traits<char>::int_type, 4> utf8_bytes = {{0, 0, 0, 0}};
2334
2336 std::size_t utf8_bytes_index = 0;
2338 std::size_t utf8_bytes_filled = 0;
2339};
2340
2341class input_adapter
2342{
2343 public:
2344 // native support
2345
2347 input_adapter(std::istream& i)
2348 : ia(std::make_shared<input_stream_adapter>(i)) {}
2349
2351 input_adapter(std::istream&& i)
2352 : ia(std::make_shared<input_stream_adapter>(i)) {}
2353
2354 input_adapter(const std::wstring& ws)
2355 : ia(std::make_shared<wide_string_input_adapter<std::wstring>>(ws)) {}
2356
2357 input_adapter(const std::u16string& ws)
2358 : ia(std::make_shared<wide_string_input_adapter<std::u16string>>(ws)) {}
2359
2360 input_adapter(const std::u32string& ws)
2361 : ia(std::make_shared<wide_string_input_adapter<std::u32string>>(ws)) {}
2362
2364 template<typename CharT,
2365 typename std::enable_if<
2366 std::is_pointer<CharT>::value and
2367 std::is_integral<typename std::remove_pointer<CharT>::type>::value and
2368 sizeof(typename std::remove_pointer<CharT>::type) == 1,
2369 int>::type = 0>
2370 input_adapter(CharT b, std::size_t l)
2371 : ia(std::make_shared<input_buffer_adapter>(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(b), l)) {}
2372
2373 // derived support
2374
2376 template<typename CharT,
2377 typename std::enable_if<
2378 std::is_pointer<CharT>::value and
2379 std::is_integral<typename std::remove_pointer<CharT>::type>::value and
2380 sizeof(typename std::remove_pointer<CharT>::type) == 1,
2381 int>::type = 0>
2382 input_adapter(CharT b)
2383 : input_adapter(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(b),
2384 std::strlen(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(b))) {}
2385
2387 template<class IteratorType,
2388 typename std::enable_if<
2389 std::is_same<typename std::iterator_traits<IteratorType>::iterator_category, std::random_access_iterator_tag>::value,
2390 int>::type = 0>
2391 input_adapter(IteratorType first, IteratorType last)
2392 {
2393#ifndef NDEBUG
2394 // assertion to check that the iterator range is indeed contiguous,
2395 // see http://stackoverflow.com/a/35008842/266378 for more discussion
2396 const auto is_contiguous = std::accumulate(
2397 first, last, std::pair<bool, int>(true, 0),
2398 [&first](std::pair<bool, int> res, decltype(*first) val)
2399 {
2400 res.first &= (val == *(std::next(std::addressof(*first), res.second++)));
2401 return res;
2402 }).first;
2403 assert(is_contiguous);
2404#endif
2405
2406 // assertion to check that each element is 1 byte long
2407 static_assert(
2408 sizeof(typename std::iterator_traits<IteratorType>::value_type) == 1,
2409 "each element in the iterator range must have the size of 1 byte");
2410
2411 const auto len = static_cast<size_t>(std::distance(first, last));
2412 if (JSON_LIKELY(len > 0))
2413 {
2414 // there is at least one element: use the address of first
2415 ia = std::make_shared<input_buffer_adapter>(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&(*first)), len);
2416 }
2417 else
2418 {
2419 // the address of first cannot be used: use nullptr
2420 ia = std::make_shared<input_buffer_adapter>(nullptr, len);
2421 }
2422 }
2423
2425 template<class T, std::size_t N>
2426 input_adapter(T (&array)[N])
2427 : input_adapter(std::begin(array), std::end(array)) {}
2428
2430 template<class ContiguousContainer, typename
2431 std::enable_if<not std::is_pointer<ContiguousContainer>::value and
2432 std::is_base_of<std::random_access_iterator_tag, typename std::iterator_traits<decltype(std::begin(std::declval<ContiguousContainer const>()))>::iterator_category>::value,
2433 int>::type = 0>
2434 input_adapter(const ContiguousContainer& c)
2435 : input_adapter(std::begin(c), std::end(c)) {}
2436
2437 operator input_adapter_t()
2438 {
2439 return ia;
2440 }
2441
2442 private:
2444 input_adapter_t ia = nullptr;
2445};

2474
2480template<typename BasicJsonType>
2481class lexer
2482{
2483 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
2484 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
2485 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
2486 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
2487
2488 public:
2490 enum class token_type
2491 {
2492 uninitialized,
2493 literal_true,
2494 literal_false,
2495 literal_null,
2496 value_string,
2497 value_unsigned,
2498 value_integer,
2499 value_float,
2500 begin_array,
2501 begin_object,
2502 end_array,
2503 end_object,
2504 name_separator,
2505 value_separator,
2506 parse_error,
2507 end_of_input,
2508 literal_or_value
2509 };
2510
2512 static const char* token_type_name(const token_type t) noexcept
2513 {
2514 switch (t)
2515 {
2516 case token_type::uninitialized:
2517 return "<uninitialized>";
2518 case token_type::literal_true:
2519 return "true literal";
2520 case token_type::literal_false:
2521 return "false literal";
2522 case token_type::literal_null:
2523 return "null literal";
2524 case token_type::value_string:
2525 return "string literal";
2526 case lexer::token_type::value_unsigned:
2527 case lexer::token_type::value_integer:
2528 case lexer::token_type::value_float:
2529 return "number literal";
2530 case token_type::begin_array:
2531 return "'['";
2532 case token_type::begin_object:
2533 return "'{'";
2534 case token_type::end_array:
2535 return "']'";
2536 case token_type::end_object:
2537 return "'}'";
2538 case token_type::name_separator:
2539 return "':'";
2540 case token_type::value_separator:
2541 return "','";
2542 case token_type::parse_error:
2543 return "<parse error>";
2544 case token_type::end_of_input:
2545 return "end of input";
2546 case token_type::literal_or_value:
2547 return "'[', '{', or a literal";
2548 // LCOV_EXCL_START
2549 default: // catch non-enum values
2550 return "unknown token";
2551 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
2552 }
2553 }
2554
2555 explicit lexer(detail::input_adapter_t&& adapter)
2556 : ia(std::move(adapter)), decimal_point_char(get_decimal_point()) {}
2557
2558 // delete because of pointer members
2559 lexer(const lexer&) = delete;
2560 lexer(lexer&&) = delete;
2561 lexer& operator=(lexer&) = delete;
2562 lexer& operator=(lexer&&) = delete;
2563 ~lexer() = default;

2567 // locales
2569
2571 static char get_decimal_point() noexcept
2572 {
2573 const auto loc = localeconv();
2574 assert(loc != nullptr);
2575 return (loc->decimal_point == nullptr) ? '.' : *(loc->decimal_point);
2576 }
2577
2579 // scan functions
2581
2597 int get_codepoint()
2598 {
2599 // this function only makes sense after reading `\u`
2600 assert(current == 'u');
2601 int codepoint = 0;
2602
2603 const auto factors = { 12, 8, 4, 0 };
2604 for (const auto factor : factors)
2605 {
2606 get();
2607
2608 if (current >= '0' and current <= '9')
2609 {
2610 codepoint += ((current - 0x30) << factor);
2611 }
2612 else if (current >= 'A' and current <= 'F')
2613 {
2614 codepoint += ((current - 0x37) << factor);
2615 }
2616 else if (current >= 'a' and current <= 'f')
2617 {
2618 codepoint += ((current - 0x57) << factor);
2619 }
2620 else
2621 {
2622 return -1;
2623 }
2624 }
2625
2626 assert(0x0000 <= codepoint and codepoint <= 0xFFFF);
2627 return codepoint;
2628 }
2629
2645 bool next_byte_in_range(std::initializer_list<int> ranges)
2646 {
2647 assert(ranges.size() == 2 or ranges.size() == 4 or ranges.size() == 6);
2648 add(current);
2649
2650 for (auto range = ranges.begin(); range != ranges.end(); ++range)
2651 {
2652 get();
2653 if (JSON_LIKELY(*range <= current and current <= *(++range)))
2654 {
2655 add(current);
2656 }
2657 else
2658 {
2659 error_message = "invalid string: ill-formed UTF-8 byte";
2660 return false;
2661 }
2662 }
2663
2664 return true;
2665 }
2666
2682 token_type scan_string()
2683 {
2684 // reset token_buffer (ignore opening quote)
2685 reset();
2686
2687 // we entered the function by reading an open quote
2688 assert(current == '\"');
2689
2690 while (true)
2691 {
2692 // get next character
2693 switch (get())
2694 {
2695 // end of file while parsing string
2696 case std::char_traits<char>::eof():
2697 {
2698 error_message = "invalid string: missing closing quote";
2699 return token_type::parse_error;
2700 }
2701
2702 // closing quote
2703 case '\"':
2704 {
2705 return token_type::value_string;
2706 }
2707
2708 // escapes
2709 case '\\':
2710 {
2711 switch (get())
2712 {
2713 // quotation mark
2714 case '\"':
2715 add('\"');
2716 break;
2717 // reverse solidus
2718 case '\\':
2719 add('\\');
2720 break;
2721 // solidus
2722 case '/':
2723 add('/');
2724 break;
2725 // backspace
2726 case 'b':
2727 add('\b');
2728 break;
2729 // form feed
2730 case 'f':
2731 add('\f');
2732 break;
2733 // line feed
2734 case 'n':
2735 add('\n');
2736 break;
2737 // carriage return
2738 case 'r':
2739 add('\r');
2740 break;
2741 // tab
2742 case 't':
2743 add('\t');
2744 break;
2745
2746 // unicode escapes
2747 case 'u':
2748 {
2749 const int codepoint1 = get_codepoint();
2750 int codepoint = codepoint1; // start with codepoint1
2751
2752 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(codepoint1 == -1))
2753 {
2754 error_message = "invalid string: '\\u' must be followed by 4 hex digits";
2755 return token_type::parse_error;
2756 }
2757
2758 // check if code point is a high surrogate
2759 if (0xD800 <= codepoint1 and codepoint1 <= 0xDBFF)
2760 {
2761 // expect next \uxxxx entry
2762 if (JSON_LIKELY(get() == '\\' and get() == 'u'))
2763 {
2764 const int codepoint2 = get_codepoint();
2765
2766 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(codepoint2 == -1))
2767 {
2768 error_message = "invalid string: '\\u' must be followed by 4 hex digits";
2769 return token_type::parse_error;
2770 }
2771
2772 // check if codepoint2 is a low surrogate
2773 if (JSON_LIKELY(0xDC00 <= codepoint2 and codepoint2 <= 0xDFFF))
2774 {
2775 // overwrite codepoint
2776 codepoint =
2777 // high surrogate occupies the most significant 22 bits
2778 (codepoint1 << 10)
2779 // low surrogate occupies the least significant 15 bits
2780 + codepoint2
2781 // there is still the 0xD800, 0xDC00 and 0x10000 noise
2782 // in the result so we have to subtract with:
2783 // (0xD800 << 10) + DC00 - 0x10000 = 0x35FDC00
2784 - 0x35FDC00;
2785 }
2786 else
2787 {
2788 error_message = "invalid string: surrogate U+DC00..U+DFFF must be followed by U+DC00..U+DFFF";
2789 return token_type::parse_error;
2790 }
2791 }
2792 else
2793 {
2794 error_message = "invalid string: surrogate U+DC00..U+DFFF must be followed by U+DC00..U+DFFF";
2795 return token_type::parse_error;
2796 }
2797 }
2798 else
2799 {
2800 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(0xDC00 <= codepoint1 and codepoint1 <= 0xDFFF))
2801 {
2802 error_message = "invalid string: surrogate U+DC00..U+DFFF must follow U+D800..U+DBFF";
2803 return token_type::parse_error;
2804 }
2805 }
2806
2807 // result of the above calculation yields a proper codepoint
2808 assert(0x00 <= codepoint and codepoint <= 0x10FFFF);
2809
2810 // translate codepoint into bytes
2811 if (codepoint < 0x80)
2812 {
2813 // 1-byte characters: 0xxxxxxx (ASCII)
2814 add(codepoint);
2815 }
2816 else if (codepoint <= 0x7FF)
2817 {
2818 // 2-byte characters: 110xxxxx 10xxxxxx
2819 add(0xC0 | (codepoint >> 6));
2820 add(0x80 | (codepoint & 0x3F));
2821 }
2822 else if (codepoint <= 0xFFFF)
2823 {
2824 // 3-byte characters: 1110xxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx
2825 add(0xE0 | (codepoint >> 12));
2826 add(0x80 | ((codepoint >> 6) & 0x3F));
2827 add(0x80 | (codepoint & 0x3F));
2828 }
2829 else
2830 {
2831 // 4-byte characters: 11110xxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx
2832 add(0xF0 | (codepoint >> 18));
2833 add(0x80 | ((codepoint >> 12) & 0x3F));
2834 add(0x80 | ((codepoint >> 6) & 0x3F));
2835 add(0x80 | (codepoint & 0x3F));
2836 }
2837
2838 break;
2839 }
2840
2841 // other characters after escape
2842 default:
2843 error_message = "invalid string: forbidden character after backslash";
2844 return token_type::parse_error;
2845 }
2846
2847 break;
2848 }

3188 }
3189 break;
3190 }
3191
3192 // U+1000..U+CFFF: bytes E1..EC 80..BF 80..BF
3193 // U+E000..U+FFFF: bytes EE..EF 80..BF 80..BF
3194 case 0xE1:
3195 case 0xE2:
3196 case 0xE3:
3197 case 0xE4:
3198 case 0xE5:
3199 case 0xE6:
3200 case 0xE7:
3201 case 0xE8:
3202 case 0xE9:
3203 case 0xEA:
3204 case 0xEB:
3205 case 0xEC:
3206 case 0xEE:
3207 case 0xEF:
3208 {
3209 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not (next_byte_in_range({0x80, 0xBF, 0x80, 0xBF}))))
3210 {
3211 return token_type::parse_error;
3212 }
3213 break;
3214 }
3215
3216 // U+D000..U+D7FF: bytes ED 80..9F 80..BF
3217 case 0xED:
3218 {
3219 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not (next_byte_in_range({0x80, 0x9F, 0x80, 0xBF}))))
3220 {
3221 return token_type::parse_error;
3222 }
3223 break;
3224 }
3225
3226 // U+10000..U+3FFFF F0 90..BF 80..BF 80..BF
3227 case 0xF0:
3228 {
3229 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not (next_byte_in_range({0x90, 0xBF, 0x80, 0xBF, 0x80, 0xBF}))))
3230 {
3231 return token_type::parse_error;
3232 }
3233 break;
3234 }
3235
3236 // U+40000..U+FFFFF F1..F3 80..BF 80..BF 80..BF
3237 case 0xF1:
3238 case 0xF2:
3239 case 0xF3:
3240 {
3241 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not (next_byte_in_range({0x80, 0xBF, 0x80, 0xBF, 0x80, 0xBF}))))
3242 {
3243 return token_type::parse_error;
3244 }
3245 break;
3246 }
3247
3248 // U+100000..U+10FFFF F4 80..8F 80..BF 80..BF
3249 case 0xF4:
3250 {
3251 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not (next_byte_in_range({0x80, 0x8F, 0x80, 0xBF, 0x80, 0xBF}))))
3252 {
3253 return token_type::parse_error;
3254 }
3255 break;
3256 }
3257
3258 // remaining bytes (80..C1 and F5..FF) are ill-formed
3259 default:
3260 {
3261 error_message = "invalid string: ill-formed UTF-8 byte";
3262 return token_type::parse_error;
3263 }
3264 }
3265 }
3266 }
3267
3268 static void strtof(float& f, const char* str, char** endptr) noexcept
3269 {
3270 f = std::strtof(str, endptr);
3271 }
3272
3273 static void strtof(double& f, const char* str, char** endptr) noexcept
3274 {
3275 f = std::strtod(str, endptr);
3276 }
3277
3278 static void strtof(long double& f, const char* str, char** endptr) noexcept
3279 {
3280 f = std::strtold(str, endptr);
3281 }

3323 token_type scan_number() // lgtm [cpp/use-of-goto]
3324 {
3325 // reset token_buffer to store the number's bytes
3326 reset();
3327
3328 // the type of the parsed number; initially set to unsigned; will be
3329 // changed if minus sign, decimal point or exponent is read
3330 token_type number_type = token_type::value_unsigned;
3331
3332 // state (init): we just found out we need to scan a number
3333 switch (current)
3334 {
3335 case '-':
3336 {
3337 add(current);
3338 goto scan_number_minus;
3339 }
3340
3341 case '0':
3342 {
3343 add(current);
3344 goto scan_number_zero;
3345 }
3346
3347 case '1':
3348 case '2':
3349 case '3':
3350 case '4':
3351 case '5':
3352 case '6':
3353 case '7':
3354 case '8':
3355 case '9':
3356 {
3357 add(current);
3358 goto scan_number_any1;
3359 }
3360
3361 // LCOV_EXCL_START
3362 default:
3363 {
3364 // all other characters are rejected outside scan_number()
3365 assert(false);
3366 }
3367 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
3368 }
3369
3370scan_number_minus:
3371 // state: we just parsed a leading minus sign
3372 number_type = token_type::value_integer;
3373 switch (get())
3374 {
3375 case '0':
3376 {
3377 add(current);
3378 goto scan_number_zero;
3379 }
3380
3381 case '1':
3382 case '2':
3383 case '3':
3384 case '4':
3385 case '5':
3386 case '6':
3387 case '7':
3388 case '8':
3389 case '9':
3390 {
3391 add(current);
3392 goto scan_number_any1;
3393 }
3394
3395 default:
3396 {
3397 error_message = "invalid number; expected digit after '-'";
3398 return token_type::parse_error;
3399 }
3400 }
3401
3402scan_number_zero:
3403 // state: we just parse a zero (maybe with a leading minus sign)
3404 switch (get())
3405 {
3406 case '.':
3407 {
3408 add(decimal_point_char);
3409 goto scan_number_decimal1;
3410 }
3411
3412 case 'e':
3413 case 'E':
3414 {
3415 add(current);
3416 goto scan_number_exponent;
3417 }
3418
3419 default:
3420 goto scan_number_done;
3421 }
3422
3423scan_number_any1:
3424 // state: we just parsed a number 0-9 (maybe with a leading minus sign)
3425 switch (get())
3426 {
3427 case '0':
3428 case '1':
3429 case '2':
3430 case '3':
3431 case '4':
3432 case '5':
3433 case '6':
3434 case '7':
3435 case '8':
3436 case '9':
3437 {
3438 add(current);
3439 goto scan_number_any1;
3440 }
3441
3442 case '.':
3443 {
3444 add(decimal_point_char);
3445 goto scan_number_decimal1;
3446 }
3447
3448 case 'e':
3449 case 'E':
3450 {
3451 add(current);
3452 goto scan_number_exponent;
3453 }
3454
3455 default:
3456 goto scan_number_done;
3457 }
3458
3459scan_number_decimal1:
3460 // state: we just parsed a decimal point
3461 number_type = token_type::value_float;
3462 switch (get())
3463 {
3464 case '0':
3465 case '1':
3466 case '2':
3467 case '3':
3468 case '4':
3469 case '5':
3470 case '6':
3471 case '7':
3472 case '8':
3473 case '9':
3474 {
3475 add(current);
3476 goto scan_number_decimal2;
3477 }
3478
3479 default:
3480 {
3481 error_message = "invalid number; expected digit after '.'";
3482 return token_type::parse_error;
3483 }
3484 }
3485
3486scan_number_decimal2:
3487 // we just parsed at least one number after a decimal point
3488 switch (get())
3489 {
3490 case '0':
3491 case '1':
3492 case '2':
3493 case '3':
3494 case '4':
3495 case '5':
3496 case '6':
3497 case '7':
3498 case '8':
3499 case '9':
3500 {
3501 add(current);
3502 goto scan_number_decimal2;
3503 }
3504
3505 case 'e':
3506 case 'E':
3507 {
3508 add(current);
3509 goto scan_number_exponent;
3510 }
3511
3512 default:
3513 goto scan_number_done;
3514 }
3515
3516scan_number_exponent:
3517 // we just parsed an exponent
3518 number_type = token_type::value_float;
3519 switch (get())
3520 {
3521 case '+':
3522 case '-':
3523 {
3524 add(current);
3525 goto scan_number_sign;
3526 }
3527
3528 case '0':
3529 case '1':
3530 case '2':
3531 case '3':
3532 case '4':
3533 case '5':
3534 case '6':
3535 case '7':
3536 case '8':
3537 case '9':
3538 {
3539 add(current);
3540 goto scan_number_any2;
3541 }
3542
3543 default:
3544 {
3545 error_message =
3546 "invalid number; expected '+', '-', or digit after exponent";
3547 return token_type::parse_error;
3548 }
3549 }
3550
3551scan_number_sign:
3552 // we just parsed an exponent sign
3553 switch (get())
3554 {
3555 case '0':
3556 case '1':
3557 case '2':
3558 case '3':
3559 case '4':
3560 case '5':
3561 case '6':
3562 case '7':
3563 case '8':
3564 case '9':
3565 {
3566 add(current);
3567 goto scan_number_any2;
3568 }
3569
3570 default:
3571 {
3572 error_message = "invalid number; expected digit after exponent sign";
3573 return token_type::parse_error;
3574 }
3575 }
3576
3577scan_number_any2:
3578 // we just parsed a number after the exponent or exponent sign
3579 switch (get())
3580 {
3581 case '0':
3582 case '1':
3583 case '2':
3584 case '3':
3585 case '4':
3586 case '5':
3587 case '6':
3588 case '7':
3589 case '8':
3590 case '9':
3591 {
3592 add(current);
3593 goto scan_number_any2;
3594 }
3595
3596 default:
3597 goto scan_number_done;
3598 }
3599
3600scan_number_done:
3601 // unget the character after the number (we only read it to know that
3602 // we are done scanning a number)
3603 unget();
3604
3605 char* endptr = nullptr;
3606 errno = 0;
3607
3608 // try to parse integers first and fall back to floats
3609 if (number_type == token_type::value_unsigned)
3610 {
3611 const auto x = std::strtoull(token_buffer.data(), &endptr, 10);
3612
3613 // we checked the number format before
3614 assert(endptr == token_buffer.data() + token_buffer.size());
3615
3616 if (errno == 0)
3617 {
3618 value_unsigned = static_cast<number_unsigned_t>(x);
3619 if (value_unsigned == x)
3620 {
3621 return token_type::value_unsigned;
3622 }
3623 }
3624 }
3625 else if (number_type == token_type::value_integer)
3626 {
3627 const auto x = std::strtoll(token_buffer.data(), &endptr, 10);
3628
3629 // we checked the number format before
3630 assert(endptr == token_buffer.data() + token_buffer.size());
3631
3632 if (errno == 0)
3633 {
3634 value_integer = static_cast<number_integer_t>(x);
3635 if (value_integer == x)
3636 {
3637 return token_type::value_integer;
3638 }
3639 }
3640 }
3641
3642 // this code is reached if we parse a floating-point number or if an
3643 // integer conversion above failed
3644 strtof(value_float, token_buffer.data(), &endptr);
3645
3646 // we checked the number format before
3647 assert(endptr == token_buffer.data() + token_buffer.size());
3648
3649 return token_type::value_float;
3650 }
3651
3657 token_type scan_literal(const char* literal_text, const std::size_t length,
3658 token_type return_type)
3659 {
3660 assert(current == literal_text[0]);
3661 for (std::size_t i = 1; i < length; ++i)
3662 {
3663 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(get() != literal_text[i]))
3664 {
3665 error_message = "invalid literal";
3666 return token_type::parse_error;
3667 }
3668 }
3669 return return_type;
3670 }

3673 // input management
3675
3677 void reset() noexcept
3678 {
3679 token_buffer.clear();
3680 token_string.clear();
3681 token_string.push_back(std::char_traits<char>::to_char_type(current));
3682 }
3683
3684 /*
3685 @brief get next character from the input
3686
3687 This function provides the interface to the used input adapter. It does
3688 not throw in case the input reached EOF, but returns a
3689 `std::char_traits<char>::eof()` in that case. Stores the scanned characters
3690 for use in error messages.
3691
3692 @return character read from the input
3693 */
3694 std::char_traits<char>::int_type get()
3695 {
3696 ++position.chars_read_total;
3697 ++position.chars_read_current_line;
3698
3699 if (next_unget)
3700 {
3701 // just reset the next_unget variable and work with current
3702 next_unget = false;
3703 }
3704 else
3705 {
3706 current = ia->get_character();
3707 }
3708
3709 if (JSON_LIKELY(current != std::char_traits<char>::eof()))
3710 {
3711 token_string.push_back(std::char_traits<char>::to_char_type(current));
3712 }
3713
3714 if (current == '\n')
3715 {
3716 ++position.lines_read;
3717 ++position.chars_read_current_line = 0;
3718 }
3719
3720 return current;
3721 }
3722
3731 void unget()
3732 {
3733 next_unget = true;
3734
3735 --position.chars_read_total;
3736
3737 // in case we "unget" a newline, we have to also decrement the lines_read
3738 if (position.chars_read_current_line == 0)
3739 {
3740 if (position.lines_read > 0)
3741 {
3742 --position.lines_read;
3743 }
3744 }
3745 else
3746 {
3747 --position.chars_read_current_line;
3748 }
3749
3750 if (JSON_LIKELY(current != std::char_traits<char>::eof()))
3751 {
3752 assert(token_string.size() != 0);
3753 token_string.pop_back();
3754 }
3755 }
3756
3758 void add(int c)
3759 {
3760 token_buffer.push_back(std::char_traits<char>::to_char_type(c));
3761 }
3762
3763 public:
3765 // value getters
3767
3769 constexpr number_integer_t get_number_integer() const noexcept
3770 {
3771 return value_integer;
3772 }
3773
3775 constexpr number_unsigned_t get_number_unsigned() const noexcept
3776 {
3777 return value_unsigned;
3778 }
3779
3781 constexpr number_float_t get_number_float() const noexcept
3782 {
3783 return value_float;
3784 }
3785
3787 string_t& get_string()
3788 {
3789 return token_buffer;
3790 }
3791
3793 // diagnostics
3795
3797 constexpr position_t get_position() const noexcept
3798 {
3799 return position;
3800 }
3801
3805 std::string get_token_string() const
3806 {
3807 // escape control characters
3808 std::string result;
3809 for (const auto c : token_string)
3810 {
3811 if ('\x00' <= c and c <= '\x1F')
3812 {
3813 // escape control characters
3814 char cs[9];
3815 (std::snprintf)(cs, 9, "<U+%.4X>", static_cast<unsigned char>(c));
3816 result += cs;
3817 }
3818 else
3819 {
3820 // add character as is
3821 result.push_back(c);
3822 }
3823 }
3824
3825 return result;
3826 }
3827
3829 constexpr const char* get_error_message() const noexcept
3830 {
3831 return error_message;
3832 }
3833
3835 // actual scanner
3837
3842 bool skip_bom()
3843 {
3844 if (get() == 0xEF)
3845 {
3846 // check if we completely parse the BOM
3847 return get() == 0xBB and get() == 0xBF;
3848 }
3849
3850 // the first character is not the beginning of the BOM; unget it to
3851 // process is later
3852 unget();
3853 return true;
3854 }
3855
3856 token_type scan()
3857 {
3858 // initially, skip the BOM
3859 if (position.chars_read_total == 0 and not skip_bom())
3860 {
3861 error_message = "invalid BOM; must be 0xEF 0xBB 0xBF if given";
3862 return token_type::parse_error;
3863 }
3864
3865 // read next character and ignore whitespace
3866 do
3867 {
3868 get();
3869 }
3870 while (current == ' ' or current == '\t' or current == '\n' or current == '\r');
3871
3872 switch (current)
3873 {
3874 // structural characters
3875 case '[':
3876 return token_type::begin_array;
3877 case ']':
3878 return token_type::end_array;
3879 case '{':
3880 return token_type::begin_object;
3881 case '}':
3882 return token_type::end_object;
3883 case ':':
3884 return token_type::name_separator;
3885 case ',':
3886 return token_type::value_separator;
3887
3888 // literals
3889 case 't':
3890 return scan_literal("true", 4, token_type::literal_true);
3891 case 'f':
3892 return scan_literal("false", 5, token_type::literal_false);
3893 case 'n':
3894 return scan_literal("null", 4, token_type::literal_null);
3895
3896 // string
3897 case '\"':
3898 return scan_string();
3899
3900 // number
3901 case '-':
3902 case '0':
3903 case '1':
3904 case '2':
3905 case '3':
3906 case '4':
3907 case '5':
3908 case '6':
3909 case '7':
3910 case '8':
3911 case '9':
3912 return scan_number();
3913
3914 // end of input (the null byte is needed when parsing from
3915 // string literals)
3916 case '\0':
3917 case std::char_traits<char>::eof():
3918 return token_type::end_of_input;
3919
3920 // error
3921 default:
3922 error_message = "invalid literal";
3923 return token_type::parse_error;
3924 }
3925 }
3926
3927 private:
3929 detail::input_adapter_t ia = nullptr;
3930
3932 std::char_traits<char>::int_type current = std::char_traits<char>::eof();
3933
3935 bool next_unget = false;
3936
3938 position_t position;
3939
3941 std::vector<char> token_string {};
3942
3944 string_t token_buffer {};
3945
3947 const char* error_message = "";
3948
3949 // number values
3950 number_integer_t value_integer = 0;
3951 number_unsigned_t value_unsigned = 0;
3952 number_float_t value_float = 0;
3953
3955 const char decimal_point_char = '.';
3956};

3989template <typename T>
3990using null_function_t = decltype(std::declval<T&>().null());
3991
3992template <typename T>
3993using boolean_function_t =
3994 decltype(std::declval<T&>().boolean(std::declval<bool>()));
3995
3996template <typename T, typename Integer>
3997using number_integer_function_t =
3998 decltype(std::declval<T&>().number_integer(std::declval<Integer>()));
3999
4000template <typename T, typename Unsigned>
4001using number_unsigned_function_t =
4002 decltype(std::declval<T&>().number_unsigned(std::declval<Unsigned>()));
4003
4004template <typename T, typename Float, typename String>
4005using number_float_function_t = decltype(std::declval<T&>().number_float(
4006 std::declval<Float>(), std::declval<const String&>()));
4007
4008template <typename T, typename String>
4009using string_function_t =
4010 decltype(std::declval<T&>().string(std::declval<String&>()));
4011
4012template <typename T>
4013using start_object_function_t =
4014 decltype(std::declval<T&>().start_object(std::declval<std::size_t>()));
4015
4016template <typename T, typename String>
4017using key_function_t =
4018 decltype(std::declval<T&>().key(std::declval<String&>()));
4019
4020template <typename T>
4021using end_object_function_t = decltype(std::declval<T&>().end_object());
4022
4023template <typename T>
4024using start_array_function_t =
4025 decltype(std::declval<T&>().start_array(std::declval<std::size_t>()));
4026
4027template <typename T>
4028using end_array_function_t = decltype(std::declval<T&>().end_array());
4029
4030template <typename T, typename Exception>
4031using parse_error_function_t = decltype(std::declval<T&>().parse_error(
4032 std::declval<std::size_t>(), std::declval<const std::string&>(),
4033 std::declval<const Exception&>()));

4035template <typename SAX, typename BasicJsonType>
4036struct is_sax
4037{
4038 private:
4039 static_assert(is_basic_json<BasicJsonType>::value,
4040 "BasicJsonType must be of type basic_json<...>");
4041
4042 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
4043 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
4044 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
4045 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
4046 using exception_t = typename BasicJsonType::exception;
4047
4048 public:
4049 static constexpr bool value =
4050 is_detected_exact<bool, null_function_t, SAX>::value &&
4051 is_detected_exact<bool, boolean_function_t, SAX>::value &&
4052 is_detected_exact<bool, number_integer_function_t, SAX,
4053 number_integer_t>::value &&
4054 is_detected_exact<bool, number_unsigned_function_t, SAX,
4055 number_unsigned_t>::value &&
4056 is_detected_exact<bool, number_float_function_t, SAX, number_float_t,
4057 string_t>::value &&
4058 is_detected_exact<bool, string_function_t, SAX, string_t>::value &&
4059 is_detected_exact<bool, start_object_function_t, SAX>::value &&
4060 is_detected_exact<bool, key_function_t, SAX, string_t>::value &&
4061 is_detected_exact<bool, end_object_function_t, SAX>::value &&
4062 is_detected_exact<bool, start_array_function_t, SAX>::value &&
4063 is_detected_exact<bool, end_array_function_t, SAX>::value &&
4064 is_detected_exact<bool, parse_error_function_t, SAX, exception_t>::value;
4065};
4066
4067template <typename SAX, typename BasicJsonType>
4068struct is_sax_static_asserts
4069{
4070 private:
4071 static_assert(is_basic_json<BasicJsonType>::value,
4072 "BasicJsonType must be of type basic_json<...>");
4073
4074 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
4075 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
4076 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
4077 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
4078 using exception_t = typename BasicJsonType::exception;
4079
4080 public:
4081 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, null_function_t, SAX>::value,
4082 "Missing/invalid function: bool null()");
4083 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, boolean_function_t, SAX>::value,
4084 "Missing/invalid function: bool boolean(bool)");
4085 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, boolean_function_t, SAX>::value,
4086 "Missing/invalid function: bool boolean(bool)");
4087 static_assert(
4088 is_detected_exact<bool, number_integer_function_t, SAX,
4089 number_integer_t>::value,
4090 "Missing/invalid function: bool number_integer(number_integer_t)");
4091 static_assert(
4092 is_detected_exact<bool, number_unsigned_function_t, SAX,
4093 number_unsigned_t>::value,
4094 "Missing/invalid function: bool number_unsigned(number_unsigned_t)");
4095 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, number_float_function_t, SAX,
4096 number_float_t, string_t>::value,
4097 "Missing/invalid function: bool number_float(number_float_t, const string_t&)");
4098 static_assert(
4099 is_detected_exact<bool, string_function_t, SAX, string_t>::value,
4100 "Missing/invalid function: bool string(string_t&)");
4101 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, start_object_function_t, SAX>::value,
4102 "Missing/invalid function: bool start_object(std::size_t)");
4103 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, key_function_t, SAX, string_t>::value,
4104 "Missing/invalid function: bool key(string_t&)");
4105 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, end_object_function_t, SAX>::value,
4106 "Missing/invalid function: bool end_object()");
4107 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, start_array_function_t, SAX>::value,
4108 "Missing/invalid function: bool start_array(std::size_t)");
4109 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, end_array_function_t, SAX>::value,
4110 "Missing/invalid function: bool end_array()");
4111 static_assert(
4112 is_detected_exact<bool, parse_error_function_t, SAX, exception_t>::value,
4113 "Missing/invalid function: bool parse_error(std::size_t, const "
4114 "std::string&, const exception&)");
4115};

4144template<typename BasicJsonType>
4145struct json_sax
4146{
4148 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
4150 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
4152 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
4154 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
4155
4160 virtual bool null() = 0;
4161
4167 virtual bool boolean(bool val) = 0;
4168
4174 virtual bool number_integer(number_integer_t val) = 0;
4175
4181 virtual bool number_unsigned(number_unsigned_t val) = 0;
4182
4189 virtual bool number_float(number_float_t val, const string_t& s) = 0;
4190
4197 virtual bool string(string_t& val) = 0;
4198
4205 virtual bool start_object(std::size_t elements) = 0;
4206
4213 virtual bool key(string_t& val) = 0;
4214
4219 virtual bool end_object() = 0;
4220
4227 virtual bool start_array(std::size_t elements) = 0;
4228
4233 virtual bool end_array() = 0;
4234
4242 virtual bool parse_error(std::size_t position,
4243 const std::string& last_token,
4244 const detail::exception& ex) = 0;
4245
4246 virtual ~json_sax() = default;
4247};
