4250namespace detail
4251{
4265template<typename BasicJsonType>
4266class json_sax_dom_parser
4267{
4268 public:
4269 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
4270 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
4271 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
4272 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
4273
4279 explicit json_sax_dom_parser(BasicJsonType& r, const bool allow_exceptions_ = true)
4280 : root(r), allow_exceptions(allow_exceptions_)
4281 {}
4282
4283 bool null()
4284 {
4285 handle_value(nullptr);
4286 return true;
4287 }
4288
4289 bool boolean(bool val)
4290 {
4291 handle_value(val);
4292 return true;
4293 }
4294
4295 bool number_integer(number_integer_t val)
4296 {
4297 handle_value(val);
4298 return true;
4299 }
4300
4301 bool number_unsigned(number_unsigned_t val)
4302 {
4303 handle_value(val);
4304 return true;
4305 }
4306
4307 bool number_float(number_float_t val, const string_t& /*unused*/)
4308 {
4309 handle_value(val);
4310 return true;
4311 }
4312
4313 bool string(string_t& val)
4314 {
4315 handle_value(val);
4316 return true;
4317 }
4318
4319 bool start_object(std::size_t len)
4320 {
4321 ref_stack.push_back(handle_value(BasicJsonType::value_t::object));
4322
4323 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(len != std::size_t(-1) and len > ref_stack.back()->max_size()))
4324 {
4325 JSON_THROW(out_of_range::create(408,
4326 "excessive object size: " + std::to_string(len)));
4327 }
4328
4329 return true;
4330 }
4331
4332 bool key(string_t& val)
4333 {
4334 // add null at given key and store the reference for later
4335 object_element = &(ref_stack.back()->m_value.object->operator[](val));
4336 return true;
4337 }
4338
4339 bool end_object()
4340 {
4341 ref_stack.pop_back();
4342 return true;
4343 }
4344
4345 bool start_array(std::size_t len)
4346 {
4347 ref_stack.push_back(handle_value(BasicJsonType::value_t::array));
4348
4349 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(len != std::size_t(-1) and len > ref_stack.back()->max_size()))
4350 {
4351 JSON_THROW(out_of_range::create(408,
4352 "excessive array size: " + std::to_string(len)));
4353 }
4354
4355 return true;
4356 }
4357
4358 bool end_array()
4359 {
4360 ref_stack.pop_back();
4361 return true;
4362 }
4363
4364 bool parse_error(std::size_t /*unused*/, const std::string& /*unused*/,
4365 const detail::exception& ex)
4366 {
4367 errored = true;
4368 if (allow_exceptions)
4369 {
4370 // determine the proper exception type from the id
4371 switch ((ex.id / 100) % 100)
4372 {
4373 case 1:
4374 JSON_THROW(*reinterpret_cast<const detail::parse_error*>(&ex));
4375 case 4:
4376 JSON_THROW(*reinterpret_cast<const detail::out_of_range*>(&ex));
4377 // LCOV_EXCL_START
4378 case 2:
4379 JSON_THROW(*reinterpret_cast<const detail::invalid_iterator*>(&ex));
4380 case 3:
4381 JSON_THROW(*reinterpret_cast<const detail::type_error*>(&ex));
4382 case 5:
4383 JSON_THROW(*reinterpret_cast<const detail::other_error*>(&ex));
4384 default:
4385 assert(false);
4386 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
4387 }
4388 }
4389 return false;
4390 }
4391
4392 constexpr bool is_errored() const
4393 {
4394 return errored;
4395 }
4396
4397 private:
4404 template<typename Value>
4405 BasicJsonType* handle_value(Value&& v)
4406 {
4407 if (ref_stack.empty())
4408 {
4409 root = BasicJsonType(std::forward<Value>(v));
4410 return &root;
4411 }
4412
4413 assert(ref_stack.back()->is_array() or ref_stack.back()->is_object());
4414
4415 if (ref_stack.back()->is_array())
4416 {
4417 ref_stack.back()->m_value.array->emplace_back(std::forward<Value>(v));
4418 return &(ref_stack.back()->m_value.array->back());
4419 }
4420 else
4421 {
4422 assert(object_element);
4423 *object_element = BasicJsonType(std::forward<Value>(v));
4424 return object_element;
4425 }
4426 }
4427
4429 BasicJsonType& root;
4431 std::vector<BasicJsonType*> ref_stack;
4433 BasicJsonType* object_element = nullptr;
4435 bool errored = false;
4437 const bool allow_exceptions = true;
4438};
4439
4440template<typename BasicJsonType>
4441class json_sax_dom_callback_parser
4442{
4443 public:
4444 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
4445 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
4446 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
4447 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
4448 using parser_callback_t = typename BasicJsonType::parser_callback_t;
4449 using parse_event_t = typename BasicJsonType::parse_event_t;
4450
4451 json_sax_dom_callback_parser(BasicJsonType& r,
4452 const parser_callback_t cb,
4453 const bool allow_exceptions_ = true)
4454 : root(r), callback(cb), allow_exceptions(allow_exceptions_)
4455 {
4456 keep_stack.push_back(true);
4457 }
4458
4459 bool null()
4460 {
4461 handle_value(nullptr);
4462 return true;
4463 }
4464
4465 bool boolean(bool val)
4466 {
4467 handle_value(val);
4468 return true;
4469 }
4470
4471 bool number_integer(number_integer_t val)
4472 {
4473 handle_value(val);
4474 return true;
4475 }
4476
4477 bool number_unsigned(number_unsigned_t val)
4478 {
4479 handle_value(val);
4480 return true;
4481 }
4482
4483 bool number_float(number_float_t val, const string_t& /*unused*/)
4484 {
4485 handle_value(val);
4486 return true;
4487 }
4488
4489 bool string(string_t& val)
4490 {
4491 handle_value(val);
4492 return true;
4493 }
4494
4495 bool start_object(std::size_t len)
4496 {
4497 // check callback for object start
4498 const bool keep = callback(static_cast<int>(ref_stack.size()), parse_event_t::object_start, discarded);
4499 keep_stack.push_back(keep);
4500
4501 auto val = handle_value(BasicJsonType::value_t::object, true);
4502 ref_stack.push_back(val.second);
4503
4504 // check object limit
4505 if (ref_stack.back())
4506 {
4507 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(len != std::size_t(-1) and len > ref_stack.back()->max_size()))
4508 {
4509 JSON_THROW(out_of_range::create(408,
4510 "excessive object size: " + std::to_string(len)));
4511 }
4512 }
4513
4514 return true;
4515 }
4516
4517 bool key(string_t& val)
4518 {
4519 BasicJsonType k = BasicJsonType(val);
4520
4521 // check callback for key
4522 const bool keep = callback(static_cast<int>(ref_stack.size()), parse_event_t::key, k);
4523 key_keep_stack.push_back(keep);
4524
4525 // add discarded value at given key and store the reference for later
4526 if (keep and ref_stack.back())
4527 {
4528 object_element = &(ref_stack.back()->m_value.object->operator[](val) = discarded);
4529 }
4530
4531 return true;
4532 }
4533
4534 bool end_object()
4535 {
4536 if (ref_stack.back())
4537 {
4538 if (not callback(static_cast<int>(ref_stack.size()) - 1, parse_event_t::object_end, *ref_stack.back()))
4539 {
4540 // discard object
4541 *ref_stack.back() = discarded;
4542 }
4543 }
4544
4545 assert(not ref_stack.empty());
4546 assert(not keep_stack.empty());
4547 ref_stack.pop_back();
4548 keep_stack.pop_back();
4549
4550 if (not ref_stack.empty() and ref_stack.back())
4551 {
4552 // remove discarded value
4553 if (ref_stack.back()->is_object())
4554 {
4555 for (auto it = ref_stack.back()->begin(); it != ref_stack.back()->end(); ++it)
4556 {
4557 if (it->is_discarded())
4558 {
4559 ref_stack.back()->erase(it);
4560 break;
4561 }
4562 }
4563 }
4564 }
4565
4566 return true;
4567 }
4568
4569 bool start_array(std::size_t len)
4570 {
4571 const bool keep = callback(static_cast<int>(ref_stack.size()), parse_event_t::array_start, discarded);
4572 keep_stack.push_back(keep);
4573
4574 auto val = handle_value(BasicJsonType::value_t::array, true);
4575 ref_stack.push_back(val.second);
4576
4577 // check array limit
4578 if (ref_stack.back())
4579 {
4580 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(len != std::size_t(-1) and len > ref_stack.back()->max_size()))
4581 {
4582 JSON_THROW(out_of_range::create(408,
4583 "excessive array size: " + std::to_string(len)));
4584 }
4585 }
4586
4587 return true;
4588 }
4589
4590 bool end_array()
4591 {
4592 bool keep = true;
4593
4594 if (ref_stack.back())
4595 {
4596 keep = callback(static_cast<int>(ref_stack.size()) - 1, parse_event_t::array_end, *ref_stack.back());
4597 if (not keep)
4598 {
4599 // discard array
4600 *ref_stack.back() = discarded;
4601 }
4602 }
4603
4604 assert(not ref_stack.empty());
4605 assert(not keep_stack.empty());
4606 ref_stack.pop_back();
4607 keep_stack.pop_back();
4608
4609 // remove discarded value
4610 if (not keep and not ref_stack.empty())
4611 {
4612 if (ref_stack.back()->is_array())
4613 {
4614 ref_stack.back()->m_value.array->pop_back();
4615 }
4616 }
4617
4618 return true;
4619 }
4620
4621 bool parse_error(std::size_t /*unused*/, const std::string& /*unused*/,
4622 const detail::exception& ex)
4623 {
4624 errored = true;
4625 if (allow_exceptions)
4626 {
4627 // determine the proper exception type from the id
4628 switch ((ex.id / 100) % 100)
4629 {
4630 case 1:
4631 JSON_THROW(*reinterpret_cast<const detail::parse_error*>(&ex));
4632 case 4:
4633 JSON_THROW(*reinterpret_cast<const detail::out_of_range*>(&ex));
4634 // LCOV_EXCL_START
4635 case 2:
4636 JSON_THROW(*reinterpret_cast<const detail::invalid_iterator*>(&ex));
4637 case 3:
4638 JSON_THROW(*reinterpret_cast<const detail::type_error*>(&ex));
4639 case 5:
4640 JSON_THROW(*reinterpret_cast<const detail::other_error*>(&ex));
4641 default:
4642 assert(false);
4643 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
4644 }
4645 }
4646 return false;
4647 }
4648
4649 constexpr bool is_errored() const
4650 {
4651 return errored;
4652 }
4653
4654 private:
4670 template<typename Value>
4671 std::pair<bool, BasicJsonType*> handle_value(Value&& v, const bool skip_callback = false)
4672 {
4673 assert(not keep_stack.empty());
4674
4675 // do not handle this value if we know it would be added to a discarded
4676 // container
4677 if (not keep_stack.back())
4678 {
4679 return {false, nullptr};
4680 }
4681
4682 // create value
4683 auto value = BasicJsonType(std::forward<Value>(v));
4684
4685 // check callback
4686 const bool keep = skip_callback or callback(static_cast<int>(ref_stack.size()), parse_event_t::value, value);
4687
4688 // do not handle this value if we just learnt it shall be discarded
4689 if (not keep)
4690 {
4691 return {false, nullptr};
4692 }
4693
4694 if (ref_stack.empty())
4695 {
4696 root = std::move(value);
4697 return {true, &root};
4698 }
4699
4700 // skip this value if we already decided to skip the parent
4701 // (https://github.com/nlohmann/json/issues/971#issuecomment-413678360)
4702 if (not ref_stack.back())
4703 {
4704 return {false, nullptr};
4705 }
4706
4707 // we now only expect arrays and objects
4708 assert(ref_stack.back()->is_array() or ref_stack.back()->is_object());
4709
4710 if (ref_stack.back()->is_array())
4711 {
4712 ref_stack.back()->m_value.array->push_back(std::move(value));
4713 return {true, &(ref_stack.back()->m_value.array->back())};
4714 }
4715 else
4716 {
4717 // check if we should store an element for the current key
4718 assert(not key_keep_stack.empty());
4719 const bool store_element = key_keep_stack.back();
4720 key_keep_stack.pop_back();
4721
4722 if (not store_element)
4723 {
4724 return {false, nullptr};
4725 }
4726
4727 assert(object_element);
4728 *object_element = std::move(value);
4729 return {true, object_element};
4730 }
4731 }
4732
4734 BasicJsonType& root;
4736 std::vector<BasicJsonType*> ref_stack;
4738 std::vector<bool> keep_stack;
4740 std::vector<bool> key_keep_stack;
4742 BasicJsonType* object_element = nullptr;
4744 bool errored = false;
4746 const parser_callback_t callback = nullptr;
4748 const bool allow_exceptions = true;
4750 BasicJsonType discarded = BasicJsonType::value_t::discarded;
4751};

4753template<typename BasicJsonType>
4754class json_sax_acceptor
4755{
4756 public:
4757 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
4758 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
4759 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
4760 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
4761
4762 bool null()
4763 {
4764 return true;
4765 }

4767 bool boolean(bool /*unused*/)
4768 {
4769 return true;

4797 bool key(string_t& /*unused*/)
4798 {

4826// #include <nlohmann/detail/input/lexer.hpp>
4827
4828// #include <nlohmann/detail/value_t.hpp>
4829
4830
4831namespace nlohmann
4832{
4833namespace detail
4834{
4836// parser //
4838
4844template<typename BasicJsonType>
4845class parser
4846{
4847 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
4848 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
4849 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
4850 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
4851 using lexer_t = lexer<BasicJsonType>;
4852 using token_type = typename lexer_t::token_type;
4853
4854 public:
4855 enum class parse_event_t : uint8_t
4856 {
4858 object_start,
4860 object_end,
4862 array_start,
4864 array_end,
4866 key,
4868 value
4869 };
4870
4871 using parser_callback_t =
4872 std::function<bool(int depth, parse_event_t event, BasicJsonType& parsed)>;
4873
4875 explicit parser(detail::input_adapter_t&& adapter,
4876 const parser_callback_t cb = nullptr,
4877 const bool allow_exceptions_ = true)
4878 : callback(cb), m_lexer(std::move(adapter)), allow_exceptions(allow_exceptions_)
4879 {
4880 // read first token
4881 get_token();
4882 }
4883
4894 void parse(const bool strict, BasicJsonType& result)
4895 {
4896 if (callback)
4897 {
4898 json_sax_dom_callback_parser<BasicJsonType> sdp(result, callback, allow_exceptions);
4899 sax_parse_internal(&sdp);
4900 result.assert_invariant();
4901
4902 // in strict mode, input must be completely read
4903 if (strict and (get_token() != token_type::end_of_input))
4904 {
4905 sdp.parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
4906 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
4907 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(),
4908 exception_message(token_type::end_of_input, "value")));
4909 }
4910
4911 // in case of an error, return discarded value
4912 if (sdp.is_errored())
4913 {
4914 result = value_t::discarded;
4915 return;
4916 }
4917
4918 // set top-level value to null if it was discarded by the callback
4919 // function
4920 if (result.is_discarded())
4921 {
4922 result = nullptr;
4923 }
4924 }
4925 else
4926 {
4927 json_sax_dom_parser<BasicJsonType> sdp(result, allow_exceptions);
4928 sax_parse_internal(&sdp);
4929 result.assert_invariant();
4930
4931 // in strict mode, input must be completely read
4932 if (strict and (get_token() != token_type::end_of_input))
4933 {
4934 sdp.parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
4935 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
4936 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(),
4937 exception_message(token_type::end_of_input, "value")));
4938 }
4939
4940 // in case of an error, return discarded value
4941 if (sdp.is_errored())
4942 {
4943 result = value_t::discarded;
4944 return;
4945 }
4946 }
4947 }
4948
4955 bool accept(const bool strict = true)
4956 {
4957 json_sax_acceptor<BasicJsonType> sax_acceptor;
4958 return sax_parse(&sax_acceptor, strict);
4959 }
4960
4961 template <typename SAX>
4962 bool sax_parse(SAX* sax, const bool strict = true)
4963 {
4964 (void)detail::is_sax_static_asserts<SAX, BasicJsonType> {};
4965 const bool result = sax_parse_internal(sax);
4966
4967 // strict mode: next byte must be EOF
4968 if (result and strict and (get_token() != token_type::end_of_input))
4969 {
4970 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
4971 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
4972 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(),
4973 exception_message(token_type::end_of_input, "value")));
4974 }
4975
4976 return result;
4977 }
4978
4979 private:
4980 template <typename SAX>
4981 bool sax_parse_internal(SAX* sax)
4982 {
4983 // stack to remember the hierarchy of structured values we are parsing
4984 // true = array; false = object
4985 std::vector<bool> states;
4986 // value to avoid a goto (see comment where set to true)
4987 bool skip_to_state_evaluation = false;
4988
4989 while (true)
4990 {
4991 if (not skip_to_state_evaluation)
4992 {
4993 // invariant: get_token() was called before each iteration
4994 switch (last_token)
4995 {
4996 case token_type::begin_object:
4997 {
4998 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->start_object(std::size_t(-1))))
4999 {
5000 return false;
5001 }
5002
5003 // closing } -> we are done
5004 if (get_token() == token_type::end_object)
5005 {
5006 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->end_object()))
5007 {
5008 return false;
5009 }
5010 break;
5011 }
5012
5013 // parse key
5014 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(last_token != token_type::value_string))
5015 {
5016 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
5017 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
5018 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(),
5019 exception_message(token_type::value_string, "object key")));
5020 }
5021 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->key(m_lexer.get_string())))
5022 {
5023 return false;
5024 }
5025
5026 // parse separator (:)
5027 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(get_token() != token_type::name_separator))
5028 {
5029 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
5030 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
5031 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(),
5032 exception_message(token_type::name_separator, "object separator")));
5033 }
5034
5035 // remember we are now inside an object
5036 states.push_back(false);
5037
5038 // parse values
5039 get_token();
5040 continue;
5041 }
5042
5043 case token_type::begin_array:
5044 {
5045 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->start_array(std::size_t(-1))))
5046 {
5047 return false;
5048 }
5049
5050 // closing ] -> we are done
5051 if (get_token() == token_type::end_array)
5052 {
5053 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->end_array()))
5054 {
5055 return false;
5056 }
5057 break;
5058 }
5059
5060 // remember we are now inside an array
5061 states.push_back(true);
5062
5063 // parse values (no need to call get_token)
5064 continue;
5065 }
5066
5067 case token_type::value_float:
5068 {
5069 const auto res = m_lexer.get_number_float();
5070
5071 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not std::isfinite(res)))
5072 {
5073 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
5074 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
5075 out_of_range::create(406, "number overflow parsing '" + m_lexer.get_token_string() + "'"));
5076 }
5077 else
5078 {
5079 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->number_float(res, m_lexer.get_string())))
5080 {
5081 return false;
5082 }
5083 break;
5084 }
5085 }
5086
5087 case token_type::literal_false:
5088 {
5089 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->boolean(false)))
5090 {
5091 return false;
5092 }
5093 break;
5094 }
5095
5096 case token_type::literal_null:
5097 {
5098 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->null()))
5099 {
5100 return false;
5101 }
5102 break;
5103 }
5104
5105 case token_type::literal_true:
5106 {
5107 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->boolean(true)))
5108 {
5109 return false;
5110 }
5111 break;
5112 }
5113
5114 case token_type::value_integer:
5115 {
5116 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->number_integer(m_lexer.get_number_integer())))
5117 {
5118 return false;
5119 }
5120 break;
5121 }
5122
5123 case token_type::value_string:
5124 {
5125 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->string(m_lexer.get_string())))
5126 {
5127 return false;
5128 }
5129 break;
5130 }
5131
5132 case token_type::value_unsigned:
5133 {
5134 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->number_unsigned(m_lexer.get_number_unsigned())))
5135 {
5136 return false;
5137 }
5138 break;
5139 }
5140
5141 case token_type::parse_error:
5142 {
5143 // using "uninitialized" to avoid "expected" message
5144 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
5145 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
5146 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(),
5147 exception_message(token_type::uninitialized, "value")));
5148 }
5149
5150 default: // the last token was unexpected
5151 {
5152 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
5153 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
5154 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(),
5155 exception_message(token_type::literal_or_value, "value")));
5156 }
5157 }
5158 }
5159 else
5160 {
5161 skip_to_state_evaluation = false;
5162 }
5163
5164 // we reached this line after we successfully parsed a value
5165 if (states.empty())
5166 {
5167 // empty stack: we reached the end of the hierarchy: done
5168 return true;
5169 }
5170 else
5171 {
5172 if (states.back()) // array
5173 {
5174 // comma -> next value
5175 if (get_token() == token_type::value_separator)
5176 {
5177 // parse a new value
5178 get_token();
5179 continue;
5180 }
5181
5182 // closing ]
5183 if (JSON_LIKELY(last_token == token_type::end_array))
5184 {
5185 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->end_array()))
5186 {
5187 return false;
5188 }
5189
5190 // We are done with this array. Before we can parse a
5191 // new value, we need to evaluate the new state first.
5192 // By setting skip_to_state_evaluation to false, we
5193 // are effectively jumping to the beginning of this if.
5194 assert(not states.empty());
5195 states.pop_back();
5196 skip_to_state_evaluation = true;
5197 continue;
5198 }
5199 else
5200 {
5201 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
5202 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
5203 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(),
5204 exception_message(token_type::end_array, "array")));
5205 }
5206 }
5207 else // object
5208 {
5209 // comma -> next value
5210 if (get_token() == token_type::value_separator)
5211 {
5212 // parse key
5213 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(get_token() != token_type::value_string))
5214 {
5215 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
5216 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
5217 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(),
5218 exception_message(token_type::value_string, "object key")));
5219 }
5220 else
5221 {
5222 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->key(m_lexer.get_string())))
5223 {
5224 return false;
5225 }
5226 }
5227
5228 // parse separator (:)
5229 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(get_token() != token_type::name_separator))
5230 {
5231 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
5232 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
5233 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(),
5234 exception_message(token_type::name_separator, "object separator")));
5235 }
5236
5237 // parse values
5238 get_token();
5239 continue;
5240 }
5241
5242 // closing }
5243 if (JSON_LIKELY(last_token == token_type::end_object))
5244 {
5245 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->end_object()))
5246 {
5247 return false;
5248 }
5249
5250 // We are done with this object. Before we can parse a
5251 // new value, we need to evaluate the new state first.
5252 // By setting skip_to_state_evaluation to false, we
5253 // are effectively jumping to the beginning of this if.
5254 assert(not states.empty());
5255 states.pop_back();
5256 skip_to_state_evaluation = true;
5257 continue;
5258 }
5259 else
5260 {
5261 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
5262 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
5263 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(),
5264 exception_message(token_type::end_object, "object")));
5265 }
5266 }
5267 }
5268 }
5269 }
5270
5272 token_type get_token()
5273 {
5274 return (last_token = m_lexer.scan());
5275 }
5276
5277 std::string exception_message(const token_type expected, const std::string& context)
5278 {
5279 std::string error_msg = "syntax error ";
5280
5281 if (not context.empty())
5282 {
5283 error_msg += "while parsing " + context + " ";
5284 }
5285
5286 error_msg += "- ";
5287
5288 if (last_token == token_type::parse_error)
5289 {
5290 error_msg += std::string(m_lexer.get_error_message()) + "; last read: '" +
5291 m_lexer.get_token_string() + "'";
5292 }
5293 else
5294 {
5295 error_msg += "unexpected " + std::string(lexer_t::token_type_name(last_token));
5296 }
5297
5298 if (expected != token_type::uninitialized)
5299 {
5300 error_msg += "; expected " + std::string(lexer_t::token_type_name(expected));
5301 }
5302
5303 return error_msg;
5304 }
5305
5306 private:
5308 const parser_callback_t callback = nullptr;
5310 token_type last_token = token_type::uninitialized;
5312 lexer_t m_lexer;
5314 const bool allow_exceptions = true;
5315};
5316} // namespace detail
5317} // namespace nlohmann
5318
5319// #include <nlohmann/detail/iterators/primitive_iterator.hpp>
5320
5321
5322#include <cstddef> // ptrdiff_t
5323#include <limits> // numeric_limits
5324
5325namespace nlohmann
5326{
5327namespace detail
5328{
5329/*
5330@brief an iterator for primitive JSON types
5331
5332This class models an iterator for primitive JSON types (boolean, number,
5333string). It's only purpose is to allow the iterator/const_iterator classes
5334to "iterate" over primitive values. Internally, the iterator is modeled by
5335a `difference_type` variable. Value begin_value (`0`) models the begin,
5336end_value (`1`) models past the end.
5337*/
5338class primitive_iterator_t
5339{
5340 private:
5341 using difference_type = std::ptrdiff_t;
5342 static constexpr difference_type begin_value = 0;
5343 static constexpr difference_type end_value = begin_value + 1;
5344
5346 difference_type m_it = (std::numeric_limits<std::ptrdiff_t>::min)();
5347
5348 public:
5349 constexpr difference_type get_value() const noexcept
5350 {
5351 return m_it;
5352 }
5353
5355 void set_begin() noexcept
5356 {
5357 m_it = begin_value;
5358 }
5359
5361 void set_end() noexcept
5362 {
5363 m_it = end_value;
5364 }
5365
5367 constexpr bool is_begin() const noexcept
5368 {
5369 return m_it == begin_value;
5370 }
5371
5373 constexpr bool is_end() const noexcept
5374 {
5375 return m_it == end_value;
5376 }
5377
5378 friend constexpr bool operator==(primitive_iterator_t lhs, primitive_iterator_t rhs) noexcept
5379 {
5380 return lhs.m_it == rhs.m_it;
5381 }
5382
5383 friend constexpr bool operator<(primitive_iterator_t lhs, primitive_iterator_t rhs) noexcept
5384 {
5385 return lhs.m_it < rhs.m_it;
5386 }
5387
5388 primitive_iterator_t operator+(difference_type n) noexcept
5389 {
5390 auto result = *this;
5391 result += n;
5392 return result;
5393 }
5394
5395 friend constexpr difference_type operator-(primitive_iterator_t lhs, primitive_iterator_t rhs) noexcept
5396 {
5397 return lhs.m_it - rhs.m_it;
5398 }
5399
5400 primitive_iterator_t& operator++() noexcept
5401 {
5402 ++m_it;
5403 return *this;
5404 }
5405
5406 primitive_iterator_t const operator++(int) noexcept
5407 {
5408 auto result = *this;
5409 ++m_it;
5410 return result;
5411 }
5412
5413 primitive_iterator_t& operator--() noexcept
5414 {
5415 --m_it;
5416 return *this;
5417 }
5418
5419 primitive_iterator_t const operator--(int) noexcept
5420 {
5421 auto result = *this;
5422 --m_it;
5423 return result;
5424 }
5425
5426 primitive_iterator_t& operator+=(difference_type n) noexcept
5427 {
5428 m_it += n;
5429 return *this;
5430 }
5431
5432 primitive_iterator_t& operator-=(difference_type n) noexcept
5433 {
5434 m_it -= n;
5435 return *this;
5436 }
5437};
5438} // namespace detail
5439} // namespace nlohmann

5442
5443
5444// #include <nlohmann/detail/iterators/primitive_iterator.hpp>
5445
5446
5447namespace nlohmann
5448{
5449namespace detail
5450{
5457template<typename BasicJsonType> struct internal_iterator
5458{
5460 typename BasicJsonType::object_t::iterator object_iterator {};
5462 typename BasicJsonType::array_t::iterator array_iterator {};
5464 primitive_iterator_t primitive_iterator {};
5465};

5470
5471
5472#include <ciso646> // not
5473#include <iterator> // iterator, random_access_iterator_tag, bidirectional_iterator_tag, advance, next
5474#include <type_traits> // conditional, is_const, remove_const
5475
5476// #include <nlohmann/detail/exceptions.hpp>
5477
5478// #include <nlohmann/detail/iterators/internal_iterator.hpp>
5479
5480// #include <nlohmann/detail/iterators/primitive_iterator.hpp>
5481
5482// #include <nlohmann/detail/macro_scope.hpp>
5483
5484// #include <nlohmann/detail/meta/cpp_future.hpp>
5485
5486// #include <nlohmann/detail/value_t.hpp>
5487
5488
5489namespace nlohmann
5490{
5491namespace detail
5492{
5493// forward declare, to be able to friend it later on
5494template<typename IteratorType> class iteration_proxy;
5495
5516template<typename BasicJsonType>
5517class iter_impl
5518{
5520 friend iter_impl<typename std::conditional<std::is_const<BasicJsonType>::value, typename std::remove_const<BasicJsonType>::type, const BasicJsonType>::type>;
5521 friend BasicJsonType;
5522 friend iteration_proxy<iter_impl>;
5523
5524 using object_t = typename BasicJsonType::object_t;
5525 using array_t = typename BasicJsonType::array_t;
5526 // make sure BasicJsonType is basic_json or const basic_json
5527 static_assert(is_basic_json<typename std::remove_const<BasicJsonType>::type>::value,
5528 "iter_impl only accepts (const) basic_json");
5529
5530 public:
5531
5537 using iterator_category = std::bidirectional_iterator_tag;
5538
5540 using value_type = typename BasicJsonType::value_type;
5542 using difference_type = typename BasicJsonType::difference_type;
5544 using pointer = typename std::conditional<std::is_const<BasicJsonType>::value,
5545 typename BasicJsonType::const_pointer,
5546 typename BasicJsonType::pointer>::type;
5548 using reference =
5549 typename std::conditional<std::is_const<BasicJsonType>::value,
5550 typename BasicJsonType::const_reference,
5551 typename BasicJsonType::reference>::type;
5552
5554 iter_impl() = default;
5555
5562 explicit iter_impl(pointer object) noexcept : m_object(object)
5563 {
5564 assert(m_object != nullptr);
5565
5566 switch (m_object->m_type)
5567 {
5568 case value_t::object:
5569 {
5570 m_it.object_iterator = typename object_t::iterator();
5571 break;
5572 }
5573
5574 case value_t::array:
5575 {
5576 m_it.array_iterator = typename array_t::iterator();
5577 break;
5578 }
5579
5580 default:
5581 {
5582 m_it.primitive_iterator = primitive_iterator_t();
5583 break;
5584 }
5585 }
5586 }
5587
5602 iter_impl(const iter_impl<typename std::remove_const<BasicJsonType>::type>& other) noexcept
5603 : m_object(other.m_object), m_it(other.m_it) {}
5604
5611 iter_impl& operator=(const iter_impl<typename std::remove_const<BasicJsonType>::type>& other) noexcept
5612 {
5613 m_object = other.m_object;
5614 m_it = other.m_it;
5615 return *this;
5616 }
5617
5618 private:
5623 void set_begin() noexcept
5624 {
5625 assert(m_object != nullptr);
5626
5627 switch (m_object->m_type)
5628 {
5629 case value_t::object:
5630 {
5631 m_it.object_iterator = m_object->m_value.object->begin();
5632 break;
5633 }
5634
5635 case value_t::array:
5636 {
5637 m_it.array_iterator = m_object->m_value.array->begin();
5638 break;
5639 }
5640
5641 case value_t::null:
5642 {
5643 // set to end so begin()==end() is true: null is empty
5644 m_it.primitive_iterator.set_end();
5645 break;
5646 }
5647
5648 default:
5649 {
5650 m_it.primitive_iterator.set_begin();
5651 break;
5652 }
5653 }
5654 }
5655
5660 void set_end() noexcept
5661 {
5662 assert(m_object != nullptr);
5663
5664 switch (m_object->m_type)
5665 {
5666 case value_t::object:
5667 {
5668 m_it.object_iterator = m_object->m_value.object->end();
5669 break;
5670 }
5671
5672 case value_t::array:
5673 {
5674 m_it.array_iterator = m_object->m_value.array->end();
5675 break;
5676 }
5677
5678 default:
5679 {
5680 m_it.primitive_iterator.set_end();
5681 break;
5682 }
5683 }
5684 }
5685
5686 public:
5691 reference operator*() const
5692 {
5693 assert(m_object != nullptr);
5694
5695 switch (m_object->m_type)
5696 {
5697 case value_t::object:
5698 {
5699 assert(m_it.object_iterator != m_object->m_value.object->end());
5700 return m_it.object_iterator->second;
5701 }
5702
5703 case value_t::array:
5704 {
5705 assert(m_it.array_iterator != m_object->m_value.array->end());
5706 return *m_it.array_iterator;
5707 }
5708
5709 case value_t::null:
5710 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(214, "cannot get value"));
5711
5712 default:
5713 {
5714 if (JSON_LIKELY(m_it.primitive_iterator.is_begin()))
5715 {
5716 return *m_object;
5717 }
5718
5719 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(214, "cannot get value"));
5720 }
5721 }
5722 }
5723
5728 pointer operator->() const
5729 {
5730 assert(m_object != nullptr);
5731
5732 switch (m_object->m_type)
5733 {
5734 case value_t::object:
5735 {
5736 assert(m_it.object_iterator != m_object->m_value.object->end());
5737 return &(m_it.object_iterator->second);
5738 }
5739
5740 case value_t::array:
5741 {
5742 assert(m_it.array_iterator != m_object->m_value.array->end());
5743 return &*m_it.array_iterator;
5744 }
5745
5746 default:
5747 {
5748 if (JSON_LIKELY(m_it.primitive_iterator.is_begin()))
5749 {
5750 return m_object;
5751 }
5752
5753 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(214, "cannot get value"));
5754 }
5755 }
5756 }
5757
5762 iter_impl const operator++(int)
5763 {
5764 auto result = *this;
5765 ++(*this);
5766 return result;
5767 }
5768
5773 iter_impl& operator++()
5774 {
5775 assert(m_object != nullptr);
5776
5777 switch (m_object->m_type)
5778 {
5779 case value_t::object:
5780 {
5781 std::advance(m_it.object_iterator, 1);
5782 break;
5783 }
5784
5785 case value_t::array:
5786 {
5787 std::advance(m_it.array_iterator, 1);
5788 break;
5789 }
5790
5791 default:
5792 {
5793 ++m_it.primitive_iterator;
5794 break;
5795 }
5796 }
5797
5798 return *this;
5799 }
5800
5805 iter_impl const operator--(int)
5806 {
5807 auto result = *this;
5808 --(*this);
5809 return result;
5810 }
5811
5816 iter_impl& operator--()
5817 {
5818 assert(m_object != nullptr);
5819
5820 switch (m_object->m_type)
5821 {
5822 case value_t::object:
5823 {
5824 std::advance(m_it.object_iterator, -1);
5825 break;
5826 }
5827
5828 case value_t::array:
5829 {
5830 std::advance(m_it.array_iterator, -1);
5831 break;
5832 }
5833
5834 default:
5835 {
5836 --m_it.primitive_iterator;
5837 break;
5838 }
5839 }
5840
5841 return *this;
5842 }
5843
5848 bool operator==(const iter_impl& other) const
5849 {
5850 // if objects are not the same, the comparison is undefined
5851 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(m_object != other.m_object))
5852 {
5853 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(212, "cannot compare iterators of different containers"));
5854 }
5855
5856 assert(m_object != nullptr);
5857
5858 switch (m_object->m_type)
5859 {
5860 case value_t::object:
5861 return (m_it.object_iterator == other.m_it.object_iterator);
5862
5863 case value_t::array:
5864 return (m_it.array_iterator == other.m_it.array_iterator);
5865
5866 default:
5867 return (m_it.primitive_iterator == other.m_it.primitive_iterator);
5868 }
5869 }
5870
5875 bool operator!=(const iter_impl& other) const
5876 {
5877 return not operator==(other);
5878 }
5879
5884 bool operator<(const iter_impl& other) const
5885 {
5886 // if objects are not the same, the comparison is undefined
5887 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(m_object != other.m_object))
5888 {
5889 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(212, "cannot compare iterators of different containers"));
5890 }
5891
5892 assert(m_object != nullptr);
5893
5894 switch (m_object->m_type)
5895 {
5896 case value_t::object:
5897 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(213, "cannot compare order of object iterators"));
5898
5899 case value_t::array:
5900 return (m_it.array_iterator < other.m_it.array_iterator);
5901
5902 default:
5903 return (m_it.primitive_iterator < other.m_it.primitive_iterator);
5904 }
5905 }
5906
5911 bool operator<=(const iter_impl& other) const
5912 {
5913 return not other.operator < (*this);
5914 }
5915
5920 bool operator>(const iter_impl& other) const
5921 {
5922 return not operator<=(other);
5923 }
5924
5929 bool operator>=(const iter_impl& other) const
5930 {
5931 return not operator<(other);
5932 }
5933
5938 iter_impl& operator+=(difference_type i)
5939 {
5940 assert(m_object != nullptr);
5941
5942 switch (m_object->m_type)
5943 {
5944 case value_t::object:
5945 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(209, "cannot use offsets with object iterators"));
5946
5947 case value_t::array:
5948 {
5949 std::advance(m_it.array_iterator, i);
5950 break;
5951 }
5952
5953 default:
5954 {
5955 m_it.primitive_iterator += i;
5956 break;
5957 }
5958 }
5959
5960 return *this;
5961 }
5962
5967 iter_impl& operator-=(difference_type i)
5968 {
5969 return operator+=(-i);
5970 }
5971
5976 iter_impl operator+(difference_type i) const
5977 {
5978 auto result = *this;
5979 result += i;
5980 return result;
5981 }
5982
5987 friend iter_impl operator+(difference_type i, const iter_impl& it)
5988 {
5989 auto result = it;
5990 result += i;
5991 return result;
5992 }
5993
5998 iter_impl operator-(difference_type i) const
5999 {
6000 auto result = *this;
6001 result -= i;
6002 return result;
6003 }
6004
6009 difference_type operator-(const iter_impl& other) const
6010 {
6011 assert(m_object != nullptr);
6012
6013 switch (m_object->m_type)
6014 {
6015 case value_t::object:
6016 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(209, "cannot use offsets with object iterators"));
6017
6018 case value_t::array:
6019 return m_it.array_iterator - other.m_it.array_iterator;
6020
6021 default:
6022 return m_it.primitive_iterator - other.m_it.primitive_iterator;
6023 }
6024 }
6025
6030 reference operator[](difference_type n) const
6031 {
6032 assert(m_object != nullptr);
6033
6034 switch (m_object->m_type)
6035 {
6036 case value_t::object:
6037 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(208, "cannot use operator[] for object iterators"));
6038
6039 case value_t::array:
6040 return *std::next(m_it.array_iterator, n);
6041
6042 case value_t::null:
6043 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(214, "cannot get value"));
6044
6045 default:
6046 {
6047 if (JSON_LIKELY(m_it.primitive_iterator.get_value() == -n))
6048 {
6049 return *m_object;
6050 }
6051
6052 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(214, "cannot get value"));
6053 }
6054 }
6055 }
6056
6061 const typename object_t::key_type& key() const
6062 {
6063 assert(m_object != nullptr);
6064
6065 if (JSON_LIKELY(m_object->is_object()))
6066 {
6067 return m_it.object_iterator->first;
6068 }
6069
6070 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(207, "cannot use key() for non-object iterators"));
6071 }
6072
6077 reference value() const
6078 {
6079 return operator*();
6080 }
6081
6082 private:
6084 pointer m_object = nullptr;
6086 internal_iterator<typename std::remove_const<BasicJsonType>::type> m_it;
6087};
6088} // namespace detail
6089} // namespace nlohmann

6099
6100namespace nlohmann
6101{
6102namespace detail
6103{
6105// reverse_iterator //
6107
6126template<typename Base>
6127class json_reverse_iterator : public std::reverse_iterator<Base>
6128{
6129 public:
6130 using difference_type = std::ptrdiff_t;
6132 using base_iterator = std::reverse_iterator<Base>;
6134 using reference = typename Base::reference;
6135
6137 explicit json_reverse_iterator(const typename base_iterator::iterator_type& it) noexcept
6138 : base_iterator(it) {}
6139
6141 explicit json_reverse_iterator(const base_iterator& it) noexcept : base_iterator(it) {}
6142
6144 json_reverse_iterator const operator++(int)
6145 {
6146 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator>(base_iterator::operator++(1));
6147 }
6148
6150 json_reverse_iterator& operator++()
6151 {
6152 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator&>(base_iterator::operator++());
6153 }
6154
6156 json_reverse_iterator const operator--(int)
6157 {
6158 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator>(base_iterator::operator--(1));
6159 }
6160
6162 json_reverse_iterator& operator--()
6163 {
6164 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator&>(base_iterator::operator--());
6165 }
6166
6168 json_reverse_iterator& operator+=(difference_type i)
6169 {
6170 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator&>(base_iterator::operator+=(i));
6171 }
6172
6174 json_reverse_iterator operator+(difference_type i) const
6175 {
6176 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator>(base_iterator::operator+(i));
6177 }
6178
6180 json_reverse_iterator operator-(difference_type i) const
6181 {
6182 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator>(base_iterator::operator-(i));
6183 }
6184
6186 difference_type operator-(const json_reverse_iterator& other) const
6187 {
6188 return base_iterator(*this) - base_iterator(other);
6189 }
6190
6192 reference operator[](difference_type n) const
6193 {
6194 return *(this->operator+(n));
6195 }
6196
6198 auto key() const -> decltype(std::declval<Base>().key())
6199 {
6200 auto it = --this->base();
6201 return it.key();
6202 }
6203
6205 reference value() const
6206 {
6207 auto it = --this->base();
6208 return it.operator * ();
6209 }
6210};
6211} // namespace detail
6212} // namespace nlohmann

6215
6216
6217#include <algorithm> // copy
6218#include <cstddef> // size_t
6219#include <ios> // streamsize
6220#include <iterator> // back_inserter

6222#include <ostream> // basic_ostream
6223#include <string> // basic_string

6226namespace nlohmann
6227{
6228namespace detail
6229{
6231template<typename CharType> struct output_adapter_protocol
6232{
6233 virtual void write_character(CharType c) = 0;
6234 virtual void write_characters(const CharType* s, std::size_t length) = 0;
6235 virtual ~output_adapter_protocol() = default;
6236};
6237
6239template<typename CharType>
6240using output_adapter_t = std::shared_ptr<output_adapter_protocol<CharType>>;
6241
6243template<typename CharType>
6244class output_vector_adapter : public output_adapter_protocol<CharType>
6245{
6246 public:
6247 explicit output_vector_adapter(std::vector<CharType>& vec) noexcept
6248 : v(vec)
6249 {}
6250
6251 void write_character(CharType c) override
6252 {
6253 v.push_back(c);
6254 }
6255
6256 void write_characters(const CharType* s, std::size_t length) override
6257 {
6258 std::copy(s, s + length, std::back_inserter(v));
6259 }
6260
6261 private:
6262 std::vector<CharType>& v;
6263};
6264
6266template<typename CharType>
6267class output_stream_adapter : public output_adapter_protocol<CharType>
6268{
6269 public:
6270 explicit output_stream_adapter(std::basic_ostream<CharType>& s) noexcept
6271 : stream(s)
6272 {}
6273
6274 void write_character(CharType c) override
6275 {
6276 stream.put(c);
6277 }
6278
6279 void write_characters(const CharType* s, std::size_t length) override
6280 {
6281 stream.write(s, static_cast<std::streamsize>(length));
6282 }
6283
6284 private:
6285 std::basic_ostream<CharType>& stream;
6286};
6287
6289template<typename CharType, typename StringType = std::basic_string<CharType>>
6290class output_string_adapter : public output_adapter_protocol<CharType>
6291{
6292 public:
6293 explicit output_string_adapter(StringType& s) noexcept
6294 : str(s)
6295 {}
6296
6297 void write_character(CharType c) override
6298 {
6299 str.push_back(c);
6300 }
6301
6302 void write_characters(const CharType* s, std::size_t length) override
6303 {
6304 str.append(s, length);
6305 }
6306
6307 private:
6308 StringType& str;
6309};
6310
6311template<typename CharType, typename StringType = std::basic_string<CharType>>
6312class output_adapter
6313{
6314 public:
6315 output_adapter(std::vector<CharType>& vec)
6316 : oa(std::make_shared<output_vector_adapter<CharType>>(vec)) {}
6317
6318 output_adapter(std::basic_ostream<CharType>& s)
6319 : oa(std::make_shared<output_stream_adapter<CharType>>(s)) {}
6320
6321 output_adapter(StringType& s)
6322 : oa(std::make_shared<output_string_adapter<CharType, StringType>>(s)) {}
6323
6324 operator output_adapter_t<CharType>()
6325 {
6326 return oa;
6327 }
6328
6329 private:
6330 output_adapter_t<CharType> oa = nullptr;
6331};
6332} // namespace detail
6333} // namespace nlohmann

6369// binary reader //
6371
6375template<typename BasicJsonType, typename SAX = json_sax_dom_parser<BasicJsonType>>
6376class binary_reader
6377{
6378 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
6379 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
6380 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
6381 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
6382 using json_sax_t = SAX;
6383
6384 public:
6390 explicit binary_reader(input_adapter_t adapter) : ia(std::move(adapter))
6391 {
6392 (void)detail::is_sax_static_asserts<SAX, BasicJsonType> {};
6393 assert(ia);
6394 }
6395
6403 bool sax_parse(const input_format_t format,
6404 json_sax_t* sax_,
6405 const bool strict = true)
6406 {
6407 sax = sax_;
6408 bool result = false;
6409
6410 switch (format)
6411 {
6412 case input_format_t::bson:
6413 result = parse_bson_internal();
6414 break;
6415
6416 case input_format_t::cbor:
6417 result = parse_cbor_internal();
6418 break;
6419
6420 case input_format_t::msgpack:
6421 result = parse_msgpack_internal();
6422 break;
6423
6424 case input_format_t::ubjson:
6425 result = parse_ubjson_internal();
6426 break;
6427
6428 // LCOV_EXCL_START
6429 default:
6430 assert(false);
6431 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
6432 }
6433
6434 // strict mode: next byte must be EOF
6435 if (result and strict)
6436 {
6437 if (format == input_format_t::ubjson)
6438 {
6439 get_ignore_noop();
6440 }
6441 else
6442 {
6443 get();
6444 }
6445
6446 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(current != std::char_traits<char>::eof()))
6447 {
6448 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, get_token_string(),
6449 parse_error::create(110, chars_read, exception_message(format, "expected end of input; last byte: 0x" + get_token_string(), "value")));
6450 }
6451 }
6452
6453 return result;
6454 }
6455
6463 static constexpr bool little_endianess(int num = 1) noexcept
6464 {
6465 return (*reinterpret_cast<char*>(&num) == 1);
6466 }
6467
6468 private:
6470 // BSON //
6472
6477 bool parse_bson_internal()
6478 {
6479 std::int32_t document_size;
6480 get_number<std::int32_t, true>(input_format_t::bson, document_size);
6481
6482 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->start_object(std::size_t(-1))))
6483 {
6484 return false;
6485 }
6486
6487 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not parse_bson_element_list(/*is_array*/false)))
6488 {
6489 return false;
6490 }
6491
6492 return sax->end_object();
6493 }
6494
6502 bool get_bson_cstr(string_t& result)
6503 {
6504 auto out = std::back_inserter(result);
6505 while (true)
6506 {
6507 get();
6508 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not unexpect_eof(input_format_t::bson, "cstring")))
6509 {
6510 return false;
6511 }
6512 if (current == 0x00)
6513 {
6514 return true;
6515 }
6516 *out++ = static_cast<char>(current);
6517 }
6518
6519 return true;
6520 }
6521
6533 template<typename NumberType>
6534 bool get_bson_string(const NumberType len, string_t& result)
6535 {
6536 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(len < 1))
6537 {
6538 auto last_token = get_token_string();
6539 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(112, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::bson, "string length must be at least 1, is " + std::to_string(len), "string")));
6540 }
6541
6542 return get_string(input_format_t::bson, len - static_cast<NumberType>(1), result) and get() != std::char_traits<char>::eof();
6543 }
6544
6555 bool parse_bson_element_internal(const int element_type,
6556 const std::size_t element_type_parse_position)
6557 {
6558 switch (element_type)
6559 {
6560 case 0x01: // double
6561 {
6562 double number;
6563 return get_number<double, true>(input_format_t::bson, number) and sax->number_float(static_cast<number_float_t>(number), "");
6564 }
6565
6566 case 0x02: // string
6567 {
6568 std::int32_t len;
6569 string_t value;
6570 return get_number<std::int32_t, true>(input_format_t::bson, len) and get_bson_string(len, value) and sax->string(value);
6571 }
6572
6573 case 0x03: // object
6574 {
6575 return parse_bson_internal();
6576 }
6577
6578 case 0x04: // array
6579 {
6580 return parse_bson_array();
6581 }
6582
6583 case 0x08: // boolean
6584 {
6585 return sax->boolean(static_cast<bool>(get()));
6586 }
6587
6588 case 0x0A: // null
6589 {
6590 return sax->null();
6591 }
6592
6593 case 0x10: // int32
6594 {
6595 std::int32_t value;
6596 return get_number<std::int32_t, true>(input_format_t::bson, value) and sax->number_integer(value);
6597 }
6598
6599 case 0x12: // int64
6600 {
6601 std::int64_t value;
6602 return get_number<std::int64_t, true>(input_format_t::bson, value) and sax->number_integer(value);
6603 }
6604
6605 default: // anything else not supported (yet)
6606 {
6607 char cr[3];
6608 (std::snprintf)(cr, sizeof(cr), "%.2hhX", static_cast<unsigned char>(element_type));
6609 return sax->parse_error(element_type_parse_position, std::string(cr), parse_error::create(114, element_type_parse_position, "Unsupported BSON record type 0x" + std::string(cr)));
6610 }
6611 }
6612 }
6613
6626 bool parse_bson_element_list(const bool is_array)
6627 {
6628 string_t key;
6629 while (int element_type = get())
6630 {
6631 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not unexpect_eof(input_format_t::bson, "element list")))
6632 {
6633 return false;
6634 }
6635
6636 const std::size_t element_type_parse_position = chars_read;
6637 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_bson_cstr(key)))
6638 {
6639 return false;
6640 }
6641
6642 if (not is_array)
6643 {
6644 if (not sax->key(key))
6645 {
6646 return false;
6647 }
6648 }
6649
6650 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not parse_bson_element_internal(element_type, element_type_parse_position)))
6651 {
6652 return false;
6653 }
6654
6655 // get_bson_cstr only appends
6656 key.clear();
6657 }
6658
6659 return true;
6660 }
6661
6666 bool parse_bson_array()
6667 {
6668 std::int32_t document_size;
6669 get_number<std::int32_t, true>(input_format_t::bson, document_size);
6670
6671 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->start_array(std::size_t(-1))))
6672 {
6673 return false;
6674 }
6675
6676 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not parse_bson_element_list(/*is_array*/true)))
6677 {
6678 return false;
6679 }
6680
6681 return sax->end_array();
6682 }
6683
6685 // CBOR //
6687
6695 bool parse_cbor_internal(const bool get_char = true)
6696 {
6697 switch (get_char ? get() : current)
6698 {
6699 // EOF
6700 case std::char_traits<char>::eof():
6701 return unexpect_eof(input_format_t::cbor, "value");
6702
6703 // Integer 0x00..0x17 (0..23)
6704 case 0x00:
6705 case 0x01:
6706 case 0x02:
6707 case 0x03:
6708 case 0x04:
6709 case 0x05:
6710 case 0x06:
6711 case 0x07:
6712 case 0x08:
6713 case 0x09:
6714 case 0x0A:
6715 case 0x0B:
6716 case 0x0C:
6717 case 0x0D:
6718 case 0x0E:
6719 case 0x0F:
6720 case 0x10:
6721 case 0x11:
6722 case 0x12:
6723 case 0x13:
6724 case 0x14:
6725 case 0x15:
6726 case 0x16:
6727 case 0x17:
6728 return sax->number_unsigned(static_cast<number_unsigned_t>(current));
6729
6730 case 0x18: // Unsigned integer (one-byte uint8_t follows)
6731 {
6732 uint8_t number;
6733 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, number) and sax->number_unsigned(number);
6734 }
6735
6736 case 0x19: // Unsigned integer (two-byte uint16_t follows)
6737 {
6738 uint16_t number;
6739 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, number) and sax->number_unsigned(number);
6740 }
6741
6742 case 0x1A: // Unsigned integer (four-byte uint32_t follows)
6743 {
6744 uint32_t number;
6745 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, number) and sax->number_unsigned(number);
6746 }
6747
6748 case 0x1B: // Unsigned integer (eight-byte uint64_t follows)
6749 {
6750 uint64_t number;
6751 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, number) and sax->number_unsigned(number);
6752 }
6753
6754 // Negative integer -1-0x00..-1-0x17 (-1..-24)
6755 case 0x20:
6756 case 0x21:
6757 case 0x22:
6758 case 0x23:
6759 case 0x24:
6760 case 0x25:
6761 case 0x26:
6762 case 0x27:
6763 case 0x28:
6764 case 0x29:
6765 case 0x2A:
6766 case 0x2B:
6767 case 0x2C:
6768 case 0x2D:
6769 case 0x2E:
6770 case 0x2F:
6771 case 0x30:
6772 case 0x31:
6773 case 0x32:
6774 case 0x33:
6775 case 0x34:
6776 case 0x35:
6777 case 0x36:
6778 case 0x37:
6779 return sax->number_integer(static_cast<int8_t>(0x20 - 1 - current));
6780
6781 case 0x38: // Negative integer (one-byte uint8_t follows)
6782 {
6783 uint8_t number;
6784 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, number) and sax->number_integer(static_cast<number_integer_t>(-1) - number);
6785 }
6786
6787 case 0x39: // Negative integer -1-n (two-byte uint16_t follows)
6788 {
6789 uint16_t number;
6790 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, number) and sax->number_integer(static_cast<number_integer_t>(-1) - number);
6791 }
6792
6793 case 0x3A: // Negative integer -1-n (four-byte uint32_t follows)
6794 {
6795 uint32_t number;
6796 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, number) and sax->number_integer(static_cast<number_integer_t>(-1) - number);
6797 }
6798
6799 case 0x3B: // Negative integer -1-n (eight-byte uint64_t follows)
6800 {
6801 uint64_t number;
6802 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, number) and sax->number_integer(static_cast<number_integer_t>(-1)
6803 - static_cast<number_integer_t>(number));
6804 }
6805
6806 // UTF-8 string (0x00..0x17 bytes follow)
6807 case 0x60:
6808 case 0x61:
6809 case 0x62:
6810 case 0x63:
6811 case 0x64:
6812 case 0x65:
6813 case 0x66:
6814 case 0x67:
6815 case 0x68:
6816 case 0x69:
6817 case 0x6A:
6818 case 0x6B:
6819 case 0x6C:
6820 case 0x6D:
6821 case 0x6E:
6822 case 0x6F:
6823 case 0x70:
6824 case 0x71:
6825 case 0x72:
6826 case 0x73:
6827 case 0x74:
6828 case 0x75:
6829 case 0x76:
6830 case 0x77:
6831 case 0x78: // UTF-8 string (one-byte uint8_t for n follows)
6832 case 0x79: // UTF-8 string (two-byte uint16_t for n follow)
6833 case 0x7A: // UTF-8 string (four-byte uint32_t for n follow)
6834 case 0x7B: // UTF-8 string (eight-byte uint64_t for n follow)
6835 case 0x7F: // UTF-8 string (indefinite length)
6836 {
6837 string_t s;
6838 return get_cbor_string(s) and sax->string(s);
6839 }
6840
6841 // array (0x00..0x17 data items follow)
6842 case 0x80:
6843 case 0x81:
6844 case 0x82:
6845 case 0x83:
6846 case 0x84:
6847 case 0x85:
6848 case 0x86:
6849 case 0x87:
6850 case 0x88:
6851 case 0x89:
6852 case 0x8A:
6853 case 0x8B:
6854 case 0x8C:
6855 case 0x8D:
6856 case 0x8E:
6857 case 0x8F:
6858 case 0x90:
6859 case 0x91:
6860 case 0x92:
6861 case 0x93:
6862 case 0x94:
6863 case 0x95:
6864 case 0x96:
6865 case 0x97:
6866 return get_cbor_array(static_cast<std::size_t>(current & 0x1F));
6867
6868 case 0x98: // array (one-byte uint8_t for n follows)
6869 {
6870 uint8_t len;
6871 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) and get_cbor_array(static_cast<std::size_t>(len));
6872 }
6873
6874 case 0x99: // array (two-byte uint16_t for n follow)
6875 {
6876 uint16_t len;
6877 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) and get_cbor_array(static_cast<std::size_t>(len));
6878 }
6879
6880 case 0x9A: // array (four-byte uint32_t for n follow)
6881 {
6882 uint32_t len;
6883 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) and get_cbor_array(static_cast<std::size_t>(len));
6884 }
6885
6886 case 0x9B: // array (eight-byte uint64_t for n follow)
6887 {
6888 uint64_t len;
6889 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) and get_cbor_array(static_cast<std::size_t>(len));
6890 }
6891
6892 case 0x9F: // array (indefinite length)
6893 return get_cbor_array(std::size_t(-1));
6894
6895 // map (0x00..0x17 pairs of data items follow)
6896 case 0xA0:
6897 case 0xA1:
6898 case 0xA2:
6899 case 0xA3:

6903 case 0xA7:

6905 case 0xA9:

6907 case 0xAB:
6908 case 0xAC:
6909 case 0xAD:
6910 case 0xAE:
6911 case 0xAF:
6912 case 0xB0:
6913 case 0xB1:
6914 case 0xB2:
6915 case 0xB3:
6916 case 0xB4:
6917 case 0xB5:
6918 case 0xB6:
6919 case 0xB7:
6920 return get_cbor_object(static_cast<std::size_t>(current & 0x1F));
6921
6922 case 0xB8: // map (one-byte uint8_t for n follows)
6923 {
6924 uint8_t len;
6925 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) and get_cbor_object(static_cast<std::size_t>(len));
6926 }
6927
6928 case 0xB9: // map (two-byte uint16_t for n follow)
6929 {
6930 uint16_t len;
6931 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) and get_cbor_object(static_cast<std::size_t>(len));
6932 }
6933
6934 case 0xBA: // map (four-byte uint32_t for n follow)
6935 {
6936 uint32_t len;
6937 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) and get_cbor_object(static_cast<std::size_t>(len));
6938 }
6939
6940 case 0xBB: // map (eight-byte uint64_t for n follow)
6941 {
6942 uint64_t len;
6943 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) and get_cbor_object(static_cast<std::size_t>(len));
6944 }
6945
6946 case 0xBF: // map (indefinite length)
6947 return get_cbor_object(std::size_t(-1));
6948
6949 case 0xF4: // false
6950 return sax->boolean(false);
6951
6952 case 0xF5: // true
6953 return sax->boolean(true);
6954
6955 case 0xF6: // null
6956 return sax->null();
6957
6958 case 0xF9: // Half-Precision Float (two-byte IEEE 754)
6959 {
6960 const int byte1_raw = get();
6961 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not unexpect_eof(input_format_t::cbor, "number")))
6962 {
6963 return false;
6964 }
6965 const int byte2_raw = get();
6966 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not unexpect_eof(input_format_t::cbor, "number")))
6967 {
6968 return false;
6969 }
6970
6971 const auto byte1 = static_cast<unsigned char>(byte1_raw);
6972 const auto byte2 = static_cast<unsigned char>(byte2_raw);
6973
6974 // code from RFC 7049, Appendix D, Figure 3:
6975 // As half-precision floating-point numbers were only added
6976 // to IEEE 754 in 2008, today's programming platforms often
6977 // still only have limited support for them. It is very
6978 // easy to include at least decoding support for them even
6979 // without such support. An example of a small decoder for
6980 // half-precision floating-point numbers in the C language
6981 // is shown in Fig. 3.
6982 const int half = (byte1 << 8) + byte2;
6983 const double val = [&half]
6984 {
6985 const int exp = (half >> 10) & 0x1F;
6986 const int mant = half & 0x3FF;
6987 assert(0 <= exp and exp <= 32);
6988 assert(0 <= mant and mant <= 1024);
6989 switch (exp)
6990 {
6991 case 0:
6992 return std::ldexp(mant, -24);
6993 case 31:
6994 return (mant == 0)
6995 ? std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity()
6996 : std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
6997 default:
6998 return std::ldexp(mant + 1024, exp - 25);
6999 }
7000 }();
7001 return sax->number_float((half & 0x8000) != 0
7002 ? static_cast<number_float_t>(-val)
7003 : static_cast<number_float_t>(val), "");
7004 }
7005
7006 case 0xFA: // Single-Precision Float (four-byte IEEE 754)
7007 {
7008 float number;
7009 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, number) and sax->number_float(static_cast<number_float_t>(number), "");
7010 }
7011
7012 case 0xFB: // Double-Precision Float (eight-byte IEEE 754)
7013 {
7014 double number;
7015 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, number) and sax->number_float(static_cast<number_float_t>(number), "");
7016 }
7017
7018 default: // anything else (0xFF is handled inside the other types)
7019 {
7020 auto last_token = get_token_string();
7021 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(112, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::cbor, "invalid byte: 0x" + last_token, "value")));
7022 }
7023 }
7024 }

7037 bool get_cbor_string(string_t& result)
7038 {
7039 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not unexpect_eof(input_format_t::cbor, "string")))
7040 {
7041 return false;
7042 }
7043
7044 switch (current)
7045 {
7046 // UTF-8 string (0x00..0x17 bytes follow)
7047 case 0x60:
7048 case 0x61:
7049 case 0x62:
7050 case 0x63:
7051 case 0x64:
7052 case 0x65:
7053 case 0x66:
7054 case 0x67:
7055 case 0x68:
7056 case 0x69:
7057 case 0x6A:
7058 case 0x6B:
7059 case 0x6C:
7060 case 0x6D:
7061 case 0x6E:
7062 case 0x6F:
7063 case 0x70:
7064 case 0x71:
7065 case 0x72:
7066 case 0x73:
7067 case 0x74:
7068 case 0x75:
7069 case 0x76:
7070 case 0x77:
7071 {
7072 return get_string(input_format_t::cbor, current & 0x1F, result);
7073 }
7074
7075 case 0x78: // UTF-8 string (one-byte uint8_t for n follows)
7076 {
7077 uint8_t len;
7078 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) and get_string(input_format_t::cbor, len, result);
7079 }
7080
7081 case 0x79: // UTF-8 string (two-byte uint16_t for n follow)
7082 {
7083 uint16_t len;
7084 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) and get_string(input_format_t::cbor, len, result);
7085 }
7086
7087 case 0x7A: // UTF-8 string (four-byte uint32_t for n follow)
7088 {
7089 uint32_t len;
7090 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) and get_string(input_format_t::cbor, len, result);
7091 }
7092
7093 case 0x7B: // UTF-8 string (eight-byte uint64_t for n follow)
7094 {
7095 uint64_t len;
7096 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) and get_string(input_format_t::cbor, len, result);
7097 }
7098
7099 case 0x7F: // UTF-8 string (indefinite length)
7100 {
7101 while (get() != 0xFF)
7102 {
7103 string_t chunk;
7104 if (not get_cbor_string(chunk))
7105 {
7106 return false;
7107 }
7108 result.append(chunk);
7109 }
7110 return true;
7111 }
7112
7113 default:
7114 {
7115 auto last_token = get_token_string();
7116 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(113, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::cbor, "expected length specification (0x60-0x7B) or indefinite string type (0x7F); last byte: 0x" + last_token, "string")));
7117 }
7118 }
7119 }

7126 bool get_cbor_array(const std::size_t len)
7127 {
7128 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->start_array(len)))
7129 {
7130 return false;
7131 }
7132
7133 if (len != std::size_t(-1))
7134 {
7135 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i)
7136 {
7137 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not parse_cbor_internal()))
7138 {
7139 return false;
7140 }
7141 }
7142 }
7143 else
7144 {
7145 while (get() != 0xFF)
7146 {
7147 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not parse_cbor_internal(false)))
7148 {
7149 return false;
7150 }
7151 }
7152 }
7153
7154 return sax->end_array();
7155 }
7156
7162 bool get_cbor_object(const std::size_t len)
7163 {
7164 if (not JSON_UNLIKELY(sax->start_object(len)))
7165 {
7166 return false;
7167 }
7168
7169 string_t key;
7170 if (len != std::size_t(-1))
7171 {
7172 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i)
7173 {
7174 get();
7175 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_cbor_string(key) or not sax->key(key)))
7176 {
7177 return false;
7178 }
7179
7180 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not parse_cbor_internal()))
7181 {
7182 return false;
7183 }
7184 key.clear();
7185 }
7186 }
7187 else
7188 {
7189 while (get() != 0xFF)
7190 {
7191 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_cbor_string(key) or not sax->key(key)))
7192 {
7193 return false;
7194 }
7195
7196 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not parse_cbor_internal()))
7197 {
7198 return false;
7199 }
7200 key.clear();
7201 }
7202 }
7203
7204 return sax->end_object();
7205 }

7659 bool get_msgpack_array(const std::size_t len)
7660 {

7662 {
7663 return false;

7681 bool get_msgpack_object(const std::size_t len)
7682 {

7684 {
7685 return false;
7686 }
7687
7688 string_t key;
7689 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i)
7690 {
7691 get();
7692 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_msgpack_string(key) or not sax->key(key)))
7693 {
7694 return false;
7695 }
7696
7697 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not parse_msgpack_internal()))
7698 {
7699 return false;
7700 }
7701 key.clear();
7702 }
7703
7704 return sax->end_object();

7744 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not unexpect_eof(input_format_t::ubjson, "value")))
7745 {
7746 return false;
7747 }
7748
7749 switch (current)
7750 {
7751 case 'U':
7752 {
7753 uint8_t len;
7754 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, len) and get_string(input_format_t::ubjson, len, result);
7755 }
7756
7757 case 'i':
7758 {
7759 int8_t len;
7760 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, len) and get_string(input_format_t::ubjson, len, result);
7761 }
7762
7763 case 'I':
7764 {
7765 int16_t len;
7766 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, len) and get_string(input_format_t::ubjson, len, result);
7767 }
7768
7769 case 'l':
7770 {
7771 int32_t len;
7772 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, len) and get_string(input_format_t::ubjson, len, result);
7773 }
7774
7775 case 'L':
7776 {
7777 int64_t len;
7778 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, len) and get_string(input_format_t::ubjson, len, result);
7779 }
7780
7781 default:
7782 auto last_token = get_token_string();
7783 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(113, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::ubjson, "expected length type specification (U, i, I, l, L); last byte: 0x" + last_token, "string")));
7784 }
7785 }
7786
7791 bool get_ubjson_size_value(std::size_t& result)
7792 {
7793 switch (get_ignore_noop())
7794 {
7795 case 'U':
7796 {
7797 uint8_t number;
7798 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number)))
7799 {
7800 return false;
7801 }
7802 result = static_cast<std::size_t>(number);
7803 return true;
7804 }
7805
7806 case 'i':
7807 {
7808 int8_t number;
7809 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number)))
7810 {
7811 return false;
7812 }
7813 result = static_cast<std::size_t>(number);
7814 return true;
7815 }
7816
7817 case 'I':
7818 {
7819 int16_t number;
7820 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number)))
7821 {
7822 return false;
7823 }
7824 result = static_cast<std::size_t>(number);
7825 return true;
7826 }
7827
7828 case 'l':
7829 {
7830 int32_t number;
7831 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number)))
7832 {
7833 return false;
7834 }
7835 result = static_cast<std::size_t>(number);
7836 return true;
7837 }
7838
7839 case 'L':
7840 {
7841 int64_t number;
7842 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number)))
7843 {
7844 return false;
7845 }
7846 result = static_cast<std::size_t>(number);
7847 return true;
7848 }
7849
7850 default:
7851 {
7852 auto last_token = get_token_string();
7853 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(113, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::ubjson, "expected length type specification (U, i, I, l, L) after '#'; last byte: 0x" + last_token, "size")));
7854 }
7855 }
7856 }
7857
7868 bool get_ubjson_size_type(std::pair<std::size_t, int>& result)
7869 {
7870 result.first = string_t::npos; // size
7871 result.second = 0; // type
7872
7873 get_ignore_noop();
7874
7875 if (current == '$')
7876 {
7877 result.second = get(); // must not ignore 'N', because 'N' maybe the type
7878 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not unexpect_eof(input_format_t::ubjson, "type")))
7879 {
7880 return false;
7881 }
7882
7883 get_ignore_noop();
7884 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(current != '#'))
7885 {
7886 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not unexpect_eof(input_format_t::ubjson, "value")))
7887 {
7888 return false;
7889 }
7890 auto last_token = get_token_string();
7891 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(112, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::ubjson, "expected '#' after type information; last byte: 0x" + last_token, "size")));
7892 }
7893
7894 return get_ubjson_size_value(result.first);
7895 }
7896 else if (current == '#')
7897 {
7898 return get_ubjson_size_value(result.first);
7899 }
7900 return true;
7901 }
7902
7907 bool get_ubjson_value(const int prefix)
7908 {
7909 switch (prefix)
7910 {
7911 case std::char_traits<char>::eof(): // EOF
7912 return unexpect_eof(input_format_t::ubjson, "value");
7913
7914 case 'T': // true
7915 return sax->boolean(true);
7916 case 'F': // false
7917 return sax->boolean(false);
7918
7919 case 'Z': // null
7920 return sax->null();
7921
7922 case 'U':
7923 {
7924 uint8_t number;
7925 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) and sax->number_unsigned(number);
7926 }
7927
7928 case 'i':
7929 {
7930 int8_t number;
7931 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) and sax->number_integer(number);
7932 }
7933
7934 case 'I':
7935 {
7936 int16_t number;
7937 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) and sax->number_integer(number);
7938 }
7939
7940 case 'l':
7941 {
7942 int32_t number;
7943 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) and sax->number_integer(number);
7944 }
7945
7946 case 'L':
7947 {
7948 int64_t number;
7949 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) and sax->number_integer(number);
7950 }
7951
7952 case 'd':
7953 {
7954 float number;
7955 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) and sax->number_float(static_cast<number_float_t>(number), "");
7956 }
7957
7958 case 'D':
7959 {
7960 double number;
7961 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) and sax->number_float(static_cast<number_float_t>(number), "");
7962 }
7963
7964 case 'C': // char
7965 {
7966 get();
7967 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not unexpect_eof(input_format_t::ubjson, "char")))
7968 {
7969 return false;
7970 }
7971 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(current > 127))
7972 {
7973 auto last_token = get_token_string();
7974 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(113, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::ubjson, "byte after 'C' must be in range 0x00..0x7F; last byte: 0x" + last_token, "char")));
7975 }
7976 string_t s(1, static_cast<char>(current));
7977 return sax->string(s);
7978 }
7979
7980 case 'S': // string
7981 {
7982 string_t s;
7983 return get_ubjson_string(s) and sax->string(s);
7984 }
7985
7986 case '[': // array
7987 return get_ubjson_array();
7988
7989 case '{': // object
7990 return get_ubjson_object();
7991
7992 default: // anything else
7993 {
7994 auto last_token = get_token_string();
7995 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(112, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::ubjson, "invalid byte: 0x" + last_token, "value")));
7996 }
7997 }
7998 }
7999
8003 bool get_ubjson_array()
8004 {
8005 std::pair<std::size_t, int> size_and_type;
8006 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_ubjson_size_type(size_and_type)))
8007 {
8008 return false;
8009 }
8010
8011 if (size_and_type.first != string_t::npos)
8012 {
8013 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->start_array(size_and_type.first)))
8014 {
8015 return false;
8016 }
8017
8018 if (size_and_type.second != 0)
8019 {
8020 if (size_and_type.second != 'N')
8021 {
8022 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size_and_type.first; ++i)
8023 {
8024 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_ubjson_value(size_and_type.second)))
8025 {
8026 return false;
8027 }
8028 }
8029 }
8030 }
8031 else
8032 {
8033 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size_and_type.first; ++i)
8034 {
8035 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not parse_ubjson_internal()))
8036 {
8037 return false;
8038 }
8039 }
8040 }
8041 }
8042 else
8043 {
8044 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->start_array(std::size_t(-1))))
8045 {
8046 return false;
8047 }
8048
8049 while (current != ']')
8050 {
8051 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not parse_ubjson_internal(false)))
8052 {
8053 return false;
8054 }
8055 get_ignore_noop();
8056 }
8057 }
8058
8059 return sax->end_array();
8060 }
8061
8065 bool get_ubjson_object()
8066 {
8067 std::pair<std::size_t, int> size_and_type;
8068 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_ubjson_size_type(size_and_type)))
8069 {
8070 return false;
8071 }
8072
8073 string_t key;
8074 if (size_and_type.first != string_t::npos)
8075 {
8076 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->start_object(size_and_type.first)))
8077 {
8078 return false;
8079 }
8080
8081 if (size_and_type.second != 0)
8082 {
8083 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size_and_type.first; ++i)
8084 {
8085 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_ubjson_string(key) or not sax->key(key)))
8086 {
8087 return false;
8088 }
8089 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_ubjson_value(size_and_type.second)))
8090 {
8091 return false;
8092 }
8093 key.clear();
8094 }
8095 }
8096 else
8097 {
8098 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size_and_type.first; ++i)
8099 {
8100 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_ubjson_string(key) or not sax->key(key)))
8101 {
8102 return false;
8103 }
8104 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not parse_ubjson_internal()))
8105 {
8106 return false;
8107 }
8108 key.clear();
8109 }
8110 }
8111 }
8112 else
8113 {
8114 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not sax->start_object(std::size_t(-1))))
8115 {
8116 return false;
8117 }
8118
8119 while (current != '}')
8120 {
8121 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not get_ubjson_string(key, false) or not sax->key(key)))
8122 {
8123 return false;
8124 }
8125 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not parse_ubjson_internal()))
8126 {
8127 return false;
8128 }
8129 get_ignore_noop();
8130 key.clear();
8131 }
8132 }
8133
8134 return sax->end_object();
8135 }
8136
8138 // Utility functions //
8140
8150 int get()
8151 {
8152 ++chars_read;
8153 return (current = ia->get_character());
8154 }
8155
8159 int get_ignore_noop()
8160 {
8161 do
8162 {
8163 get();
8164 }
8165 while (current == 'N');
8166
8167 return current;
8168 }
8169
8170 /*
8171 @brief read a number from the input
8172
8173 @tparam NumberType the type of the number
8174 @param[in] format the current format (for diagnostics)
8175 @param[out] result number of type @a NumberType
8176
8177 @return whether conversion completed
8178
8179 @note This function needs to respect the system's endianess, because
8180 bytes in CBOR, MessagePack, and UBJSON are stored in network order
8181 (big endian) and therefore need reordering on little endian systems.
8182 */
8183 template<typename NumberType, bool InputIsLittleEndian = false>
8184 bool get_number(const input_format_t format, NumberType& result)
8185 {
8186 // step 1: read input into array with system's byte order
8187 std::array<uint8_t, sizeof(NumberType)> vec;
8188 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(NumberType); ++i)
8189 {
8190 get();
8191 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not unexpect_eof(format, "number")))
8192 {
8193 return false;
8194 }
8195
8196 // reverse byte order prior to conversion if necessary
8197 if (is_little_endian && !InputIsLittleEndian)
8198 {
8199 vec[sizeof(NumberType) - i - 1] = static_cast<uint8_t>(current);
8200 }
8201 else
8202 {
8203 vec[i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(current); // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
8204 }
8205 }
8206
8207 // step 2: convert array into number of type T and return
8208 std::memcpy(&result, vec.data(), sizeof(NumberType));
8209 return true;
8210 }
8211
8226 template<typename NumberType>
8227 bool get_string(const input_format_t format,
8228 const NumberType len,
8229 string_t& result)
8230 {
8231 bool success = true;
8232 std::generate_n(std::back_inserter(result), len, [this, &success, &format]()
8233 {
8234 get();
8235 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(not unexpect_eof(format, "string")))
8236 {
8237 success = false;
8238 }
8239 return static_cast<char>(current);
8240 });
8241 return success;
8242 }
8243
8249 bool unexpect_eof(const input_format_t format, const char* context) const
8250 {
8251 if (JSON_UNLIKELY(current == std::char_traits<char>::eof()))
8252 {
8253 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, "<end of file>",
8254 parse_error::create(110, chars_read, exception_message(format, "unexpected end of input", context)));
8255 }
8256 return true;
8257 }
8258
8262 std::string get_token_string() const
8263 {
8264 char cr[3];
8265 (std::snprintf)(cr, 3, "%.2hhX", static_cast<unsigned char>(current));
8266 return std::string{cr};
8267 }
8268
8275 std::string exception_message(const input_format_t format,
8276 const std::string& detail,
8277 const std::string& context) const
8278 {
8279 std::string error_msg = "syntax error while parsing ";
8280
8281 switch (format)
8282 {
8283 case input_format_t::cbor:
8284 error_msg += "CBOR";
8285 break;
8286
8287 case input_format_t::msgpack:
8288 error_msg += "MessagePack";
8289 break;
8290
8291 case input_format_t::ubjson:
8292 error_msg += "UBJSON";
8293 break;
8294
8295 case input_format_t::bson:
8296 error_msg += "BSON";
8297 break;
8298
8299 // LCOV_EXCL_START
8300 default:
8301 assert(false);
8302 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
8303 }
8304
8305 return error_msg + " " + context + ": " + detail;
8306 }
8307
8308 private:
8310 input_adapter_t ia = nullptr;
8311
8313 int current = std::char_traits<char>::eof();
8314
8316 std::size_t chars_read = 0;
8317
8319 const bool is_little_endian = little_endianess();
8320
8322 json_sax_t* sax = nullptr;
8323};
8324} // namespace detail
8325} // namespace nlohmann

8329
8330#include <algorithm> // reverse
8331#include <array> // array
